canonicalLevel.name: Revenge
canonicalLevel.text: After you take a Wound, you may spend up to 2 AP as if it was your Turn, all Actions you take when doing this count as Reactions.

canonicalLevel.name: Cornered Dog
canonicalLevel.text: If you receive an Effect, you may take 2 damage instead.

canonicalLevel.name: Take A Beating
canonicalLevel.text: The first time you take damage each Turn, gain 1 Focus. If that damage would deal a Wound to you, Charge at no Cost as a Reaction.

rules.name: Скорость — это вес
rules.note: Успешное Завершение Телом после общего окна Реакций накладывает Разорван на доступные цели.

canonicalLevel.name: Speed Is Weight
canonicalLevel.text: If your Body Finisher is the first attack on your Turn, you gain 2 Focus and Shred your target before dealing damage.

canonicalLevel.name: Wide Arc
canonicalLevel.text: When spending 3 or more Focus on a Body Finisher, you can have it target enemies in a 2x2 Zone placed on yourself.

canonicalLevel.name: Titanic Heave [ Breathe → Body Finisher ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Finisher counts all dice rolled as Hits, pushes enemies it hits 2 spaces back, and Weakens you after it resolves.

canonicalLevel.name: Riposte [ Block → Skirmish ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Skirmish lets you move 3 spaces before targeting and Taunts your target.

rules.name: Парирование
rules.note: Ответ Блоком против смежного атакующего автоматически накладывает Ошеломлен до разрешения исходной Атаки.

canonicalLevel.name: Parry
canonicalLevel.text: Your Blocks give [Tension] additional Armor. Using Block against an adjacent character Dazes your Attacker and pushes them instead of you.

canonicalLevel.name: Deflecting Blow
canonicalLevel.text: After you Block an Attack and reduce its damage to 1 or less, you may spend 1 Focus to Strengthen yourself and Skirmish.

canonicalLevel.name: Thrill
canonicalLevel.text: After you receive a Negative Effect, you may also Strengthen yourself.

canonicalLevel.name: Wild Rush
canonicalLevel.text: The first time you Skirmish each Turn, before targeting, you may Blight yourself to move up to 2 spaces in a Line. If you're already Blighted, Mark yourself instead and move up to 3 spaces. If the target's Adjacent, you gain 1 Advantage for each space moved.

canonicalLevel.name: Bled Dry
canonicalLevel.text: The first attack you make each Turn deals additional damage equal to the number of different effects you have, and after it resolves you may clear a number of negative effects equal to the crits you rolled.

rules.name: Большой ствол
rules.note: Пули сохраняются и изменяются событиями ядра; Стычка проверяет минимум, дальность и явное распределение дополнительных Пуль.

canonicalLevel.name: Big Iron
canonicalLevel.text: You now use ‘Bullets' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with 6 Bullets. After you spend Bullets, you may deal 1 damage to an enemy within 4 range once per bullet spent. Before you Skirmish, you may spend any number of Bullets, if you spent any, the Skirmish targets all the characters the Bullets damaged instead of its normal targeting.

rules.name: Зарядить и взвести
rules.note: Стычки получают постоянное Преимущество; Ход без Атаки предлагает выставить Пули на 6.

canonicalLevel.name: Lock And Load
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. If you end your Turn without spending a Bullet, you can set your Bullets to 6.

rules.name: Жонглирование пулями
rules.note: Одиночная Стычка за 3+ Пули автоматически накладывает Подброшен после разрешения Реакций.

canonicalLevel.name: Bullet Juggle
canonicalLevel.text: Your attacks that roll 2 or more Crits Launch a target of your choice. Your bonus damage from "Big Iron" is doubled against Launched characters.

canonicalLevel.name: Effort
canonicalLevel.text: If you roll a 1 in any Challenge roll, you may reduce your Speed by 1 for the duration of the Scene (to a minimum of 1) to treat it as a 6 instead, converting it to a Critical Hit. If you cannot lower your Speed, you receive [Tier] damage instead.

canonicalLevel.name: Adrenaline
canonicalLevel.text: After you take damage on your Turn, you may move up to 3 spaces towards an enemy of your choice. If this brings you adjacent to the enemy, you may Mark them.

canonicalLevel.name: Defy Reason
canonicalLevel.text: You may use the effect of "Effort" on any roll that comes from a Finisher, regardless of value.

canonicalLevel.name: Twin Suns [ Cast → Skirmish ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Skirmish is Swift, costs Focus instead of AP, and you can Teleport to a space in 4 range before targeting with it.

canonicalLevel.name: Infused Edge
canonicalLevel.text: If you end a Combo in a non-Cast Attack, it becomes ‘Infused'. Infused attacks count as a Cast and let you Teleport to a space adjacent to your target after dealing damage, dealing additional damage equal to the Crits you rolled if you do.

rules.name: Охотник на ведьм
rules.note: Ядро находит непосредственно предыдущее Заклинание и его цели; комбо проверяет Завершение Телом/Талантом по тем же целям и добавляет Дух к урону.

canonicalLevel.name: Witch Hunter [ Cast → Body/Talent Finisher ]
canonicalLevel.text: If the Finisher targets the same character as the Cast, it deals [Spirit] additional damage.

canonicalLevel.name: Stretch
canonicalLevel.text: After you Charge, you ‘Stretch'. After Stretching, until the end of your next Turn, completing a Combo gives you 1 AP.

canonicalLevel.name: Perfect Form
canonicalLevel.text: After you complete a Combo, you gain [Tier/2] Armor until the start of your next Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Final Blow [ Skirmish → Finisher ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Finisher costs 1 AP and pushes its target 3 spaces away.

canonicalLevel.name: Get Back Up
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Chapter, you may spend an Influence to Resist a Knock Out without becoming Vulnerable. Doing this makes you lose the ability to gain Influence for the remainder of the Scene.

canonicalLevel.name: Furious Revival
canonicalLevel.text: After you spend an Influence in a combat Scene, you may take an Action with a cost of 1 for no cost with Swift.

canonicalLevel.name: Phoenix
canonicalLevel.text: After you Resist using "Get Back Up" you may set your Wounds to 1.

rules.name: Гордыня
rules.note: Гордость получает сегменты от Атак низкими Атрибутами и попаданий без защитной Реакции; полные часы дают Преимущество.

canonicalLevel.name: Hubris
canonicalLevel.text: Begin tracking ‘Pride', a 6 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. While your Pride Clock is full, you gain 1 Advantage on all Rolls for the remainder of the Scene. After you do one of the following, fill one Segment of this Clock: ‣ Get hit by an enemy's Attack without using a Defensive Reaction. ‣ Attack rolling one of your two lowest Attributes.

rules.name: Докажи, чего стоишь
rules.note: При заполнении предлагается очистить часы и уменьшить их размер на 2, минимум до 2.

canonicalLevel.name: Prove Yourself
canonicalLevel.text: If your Pride Clock fills, you may ‘Hold Back', emptying the Clock and reducing its total Segments by 2 (to a min of 2). If your Pride Clock has less than 6 Segments, "Hubris" grants one additional Advantage for every two Segments it is less than 6.

rules.name: Достойный противник
rules.note: Полученная Рана предлагает заполнить сегмент Гордости.

canonicalLevel.name: A Worthy Opponent
canonicalLevel.text: When an enemy attacks you, you may fill a Pride Segment.

rules.name: Картечь
rules.note: Стычка получает дальность 4; каждая цель в пределах 2 после Успеха проходит обычные Реакции и затем отталкивается на 1 через общий post-hit displacement без добавочного урона.

canonicalLevel.name: Buck Shot
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmishes can Choose a target in 4 range instead of its normal targeting. Your Skirmishes Against targets in 2 range push the target 1 space away.

canonicalLevel.name: Both Barrels
canonicalLevel.text: Before you Skirmish, so long as you're not Weakened, you can use ‘Both Barrels'. Doing this gives the Attack [Body/2] Advantage, doubles any push it deals, and Weakens you after it resolves.

canonicalLevel.name: Annihilate
canonicalLevel.text: Your Body Finisher can now target characters up to 3 spaces away and can use the effect of "Both Barrels". If you use "Both Barrels" with a Skirmish or Body Finisher, have it affect all targets in a 2x2 Zone adjacent to you.

canonicalLevel.name: Twinned blow
canonicalLevel.text: If you Skirmish targeting a single character, you may give it [Tier] disadvantage. If you do, you may ‘Flurry', Dealing [Body / 2] or [Talent / 2] damage to the same target afterwards. Flurrying counts as a Swift Skirmish at 0 cost. Other techniques cannot change Flurry's targeting.

canonicalLevel.name: Frenzied Barrage
canonicalLevel.text: If you spend 2 or more Focus on a finisher, you may give it [Tier] Disadvantage. If you do, you may ‘Flurry' twice, each of them targeting a target of the Finisher.

canonicalLevel.name: Varied Blades
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmishes have an additional two effects that alternate every time you Skirmish, resetting at the start of your Turn (first Skirmish uses effect A, second uses effect B, third uses effect A again). Choose two of the options below as effects: ‣ Astral: Gain [Tier / 2] Focus. ‣ Blazing: Deal [Tier / 2] damage to your target. ‣ Umbral: Teleport to a space within [Tier] spaces. ‣ Vorpal: Restore [Tier / 2] Health. ‣ Phasing: This attack ignores its target's Armor. ‣ Whirling: Move your target [Tier] spaces.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки
интерфейс и журнал должны объяснять подготовленные последствия

canonicalLevel.name: "Pathetic"
canonicalLevel.text: After you increase Tension on your Turn or KO Fodder, you may "Impose"; both Fearing enemies in a 3x3 Zone centered on yourself, and dealing [Tier] damage to them if they weren't already Feared.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки
интерфейс и журнал должны объяснять подготовленные последствия

canonicalLevel.name: "Out Of My Way"
canonicalLevel.text: Before you move with Stride or Jump, you may change the distance you're moving to [Body]. If you do, you may choose any characters you would move into the space of, and move them 1 space each and Impose after you end your movement.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки
интерфейс и журнал должны объяснять подготовленные последствия

canonicalLevel.name: "Fools And Dead Men"
canonicalLevel.text: After you Knock Out an enemy, gain 2 Focus and 1 AP. After you Knock Out a non-fodder NPC due to the damage dealt through Impose, place a Fodder Zone in their space.

canonicalLevel.name: Art Of The 8 Hammers
canonicalLevel.text: You can't use any part of this Technique if you use Techniques with the "weapon" tag. After you Skirmish or Body / Talent Finisher, you can use one of the following ‘follow ups' on one of your targets. Each can be used once per Round. ‣ Quick Step: Move up to 3 spaces. Gain [Tier] Evasion. ‣ Binding Blow: Snare your target. ‣ Rising Knee: Launch your target. ‣ Iron Shoulder: Push your target 3 spaces.

canonicalLevel.name: Flow-State
canonicalLevel.text: Your first Skirmish each Turn is Swift. After you trigger an effect of "Art Of The 8 Hammers", you may deal [Body / 2] or [Talent / 2] damage to a character you've attacked this Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Unlimited Blows
canonicalLevel.text: Your attacks gain 1 Advantage. If you roll at least one Crit on a Skirmish or Finisher, "Art Of The 8 Hammers" triggers an additional time.

canonicalLevel.name: Mind Made Manifest
canonicalLevel.text: While you're Strengthened, gain 2 Armor. While you're Hastened, gain 2 Evasion at the end of your Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Calm Within Chaos
canonicalLevel.text: Begin tracking "Balance", an 8 segment Clock that's emptied after every scene. Fill 1 segment each time you perform a Utility Action after an Attack Action, or an Attack Action after a Utility Action on the same Turn. At the start of your Turn, you may empty 1 segment to Strengthen or Hasten yourself.

canonicalLevel.name: Sublime Equanimity
canonicalLevel.text: After you Charge or Awaken this, you may ‘Meditate'. If you Meditate, instead of rolling, gain Evasion equal to the filled Balance segments, then empty your Balance. If your Balance was full, gain [Tier + 1] focus, teleport to any empty space, and perform a swift spirit or mind finisher on an adjacent enemy at no cost. After Meditating you cannot fill balance segments on the same Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Pierce
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmish and Body Finisher can target one enemy within 2 range instead of its normal targeting. Your Skirmishes gain Advantage equal to your target's distance from you (up to a maximum of 3).

canonicalLevel.name: Phalanx
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmish and Body Finishers can target an enemy within 3 range instead of its normal targeting. Skirmish affects all opposing targets between yourself and your original target(s), dealing half damage to each.

canonicalLevel.name: Cannon-Arm [ Breathe → Skirmish ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Skirmish can choose targets up to 4 spaces away and raises the maximum Advantage from "Pierce" to 4. If the attack had 4 or more total Advantage, it additionally affects all targets adjacent to the original, dealing half its damage to said targets. Each affected space becomes Difficult Terrain.

canonicalLevel.name: Yearn
canonicalLevel.text: The first time you Investigate each Turn, it becomes Swift, has its Cost Reduced to 0, and has a range of [Body]. However, it can only be used to ask what your target's current and maximum Health is. When any opponent is Knocked Out while adjacent to you, you heal [Body] Health.

canonicalLevel.name: Obsess
canonicalLevel.text: If you know an opponent has half their maximum Health remaining or less, your Speed is increased by 3, and you ignore Difficult Terrain, but you cannot move unless you're moving closer to at least one of said opponents.

canonicalLevel.name: Envelop
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Scene, after you heal using "Yearn" you may ‘Siphon', Immobilizing and Dazing yourself. While you're under these Effects, the Focus gained through Breathe and Charge are replaced with health, with it healing a wound and setting your health to 1 if the Health would go past your maximum.

rules.name: Всё — инструмент
rules.note: Поиск, дальность, владение и Здоровье местности готовы; выбор между созданием и удалением пока подтверждает игрок.

canonicalLevel.name: "This'll Do"
canonicalLevel.text: You can Interact to ‘Notice Something', creating an Obstacle in 5 range, or to remove an adjacent Obstacle to make a Swift Skirmish or Cast using any Attribute for its Roll.

canonicalLevel.name: "That One Hurts!"
canonicalLevel.text: You may Interact at no cost and with Swift once per Round, so long as it doesn't result in an Attack. Attacks from Interact have 3 Advantage.

canonicalLevel.name: Last Resort
canonicalLevel.text: Once per scene, you may Attack using "This'll Do", even if there isn't an Obstacle to remove. This use gives the Attack from it [Tension] Advantage.

rules.name: Небесная рука
rules.note: Зарядка при Напряжении 2+ предлагает однократную трансформацию; массовый толчок и окончание формы при 0 Здоровья автоматизированы. Выбор и временное предоставление трёх уровней оружейной Техники пока требуют отдельного профиля.

canonicalLevel.name: Heavenly Arm
canonicalLevel.text: Choose a Technique with the "Weapon" Tag. Once per Scene, After you Charge or Awaken this with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', pushing all enemies within 2 range 3 spaces away and trigger any of its Deploy effects. While Transformed you count as having all three Levels of the Technique you chose, if it has an alternate Foci, track it separately and use it as your Focus while Transformed. If you're reduced to 0 Health while Transformed, it ends, and you're Dazed.

canonicalLevel.name: Esoteric Blades
canonicalLevel.text: Choose one other Technique of any kind. While you are transformed, you count as having the first two Levels of that Technique.

rules.name: Святой меч, Дюрандаль
rules.note: Трансформация и Линия проверяются; потеря трансформации и дополнительный урон за каждую цель ещё не разрешаются полностью.

canonicalLevel.name: Saintly Sword, Heaven Piercer
canonicalLevel.text: You may lose your Transformation before you use a finisher. If you do so, that Finisher affects all targets along an infinitely long Line placed adjacent to you, dealing one additional damage for every targeted character. If you're Tier 3 or higher, you may Daze yourself and spend 2 Focus to transform as soon as you deploy regardless of Tension.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки

canonicalLevel.name: Warrior Of Legend
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Scene, After you Charge or Awaken this with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', pushing all enemies within 2 range 3 spaces away. While Transformed you are Strengthened and Reinforced at all times. If you're reduced to 0 Health while Transformed, it ends, and you're Dazed.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки

canonicalLevel.name: Hero's Feat
canonicalLevel.text: Your Transformation has an additional effect for its duration chosen from the list below. ‣ Feat Of Strength: All your push effects can have their distance doubled, and characters you push adjacent to another character both take [Tier] damage. ‣ Feat Of Speed: Before you take an Action, move up to double its Cost in spaces. If this makes you leave adjacency with enemies, deal [Tier] damage to them. ‣ Feat Of Sturdiness: Reinforced grants you 1 additional Armor. After you reduce incoming damage to 1 or less, deal [Tier] damage to the attacker.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки
интерфейс и журнал должны объяснять подготовленные последствия

canonicalLevel.name: Mastered Strength
canonicalLevel.text: .You may Daze yourself and spend 1 Focus to transform as soon as you deploy regardless of Tension.

rules.name: Над и вокруг
rules.note: Условие входа в Стойку полёта и конфликт с другой Стойкой вычисляются канонически.

canonicalLevel.name: Soar
canonicalLevel.text: After you Jump, you may Hasten yourself rather than moving. After you're Hastened, you enter ‘Flight Stance', removing other Stances you had. While in Flight, incoming Attacks have [Tier] Disadvantage, and you ignore Terrain and enemies while moving. Attacking removes Flight Stance.

canonicalLevel.name: Hunt
canonicalLevel.text: After you Attack a Launched character in Flight (and don't Spike), you may end your Turn to Disappear with them. When either of you reappear, the other appears in an adjacent space of their choice, and you deal [Speed/2] damage to all adjacent enemies.

canonicalLevel.name: Falling Ax Strike
canonicalLevel.text: The Attacks you use while in the Flight Stance can roll [Speed] rather than an Attribute. Doing so removes Hastened and Launches your target.

rules.name: Засада
rules.note: Первое действие после последнего Развертывания проверяется по журналу; только Скрыться становится бесплатным и игнорирует требования.

canonicalLevel.name: Ambush
canonicalLevel.text: If the first Action you take after Deploying is Hide, it has no Cost and ignores its requirements.

rules.name: Ликвидация
rules.note: Сохраняемый план разрешает отменяемое смежное появление; ядро повторно проверяет источник Исчезновения, клетку, цели и авторитетный бросок с [Ступень] Преимущества и критом на 5–6.

canonicalLevel.name: Assassinate
canonicalLevel.text: Attacks you make while Disappeared gain [Tier] Advantage, let you reappear adjacent to characters, and the dice rolled Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

canonicalLevel.name: Speed of Dark [ Hide → Stride ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Stride has no cost, turns you Invisible when used, and gives your next Finisher on that Turn [Speed / 2] Advantage.

review.correction: Ядро проверяет Hide→Stride, бесплатный Шаг, Invisible и [Speed/2] к следующему Finisher в том же Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Long Shot
canonicalLevel.text: Your Talent Finisher can target characters within 5 range instead of its normal targeting.

canonicalLevel.name: Bunker Down
canonicalLevel.text: At the start of the Scene, or If you end your Turn without Attacking, you may ‘Bunker Down', gaining Immobilized. While you're Immobilized, your Talent Finishers gain 5 additional range and Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

canonicalLevel.name: Deadeye [ Hide → Talent Finisher ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Finisher deals [Crits rolled] + [Distance from target] additional damage, and affects opposing targets between yourself and your original target (as per any shortest path).

canonicalLevel.name: Sting
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Turn, if you've moved with Stride on the same Turn, you may ‘Jab' an adjacent target at no Cost. A Jab deals [Talent/2] damage to its target and counts as a Swift Skirmish; features other than this Technique cannot change a Jab's damage or targeting.

canonicalLevel.name: Shifting Blows
canonicalLevel.text: You may move up to two spaces in a straight line after Skirmishing.

canonicalLevel.name: Rebound
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. If movement provided by Skirmish moves you into adjacency with a character who hasn't been attacked this Turn, you may Jab them.

canonicalLevel.name: Fade
canonicalLevel.text: You can move through enemies. You must end your movement in an empty space.

canonicalLevel.name: Flash Strike
canonicalLevel.text: After you move out of a character's space using "Fade", you may deal [Talent / 2] damage to them (this is not an Attack). You can't use this on the same target more than once each Round.

canonicalLevel.name: Flash Step [ Breathe → Stride ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Stride lets you move triple its normal distance. If you trigger "Flash Strike" while using this, you may Launch any characters you damage.

rules.name: Нырок
rules.note: Первый Уворот за Раунд автоматически получает дополнительное [Талант / 2] Уклонение.

canonicalLevel.name: Duck
canonicalLevel.text: The first time you Dodge each Round, gain [Talent] additional Evasion.

rules.name: Маятник
rules.note: Уворот перемещает до 3 клеток; если итоговое Уклонение сводит урон к 0, стол предлагает отменяемое повторное перемещение до 3 клеток и пишет его в журнал.

canonicalLevel.name: Weave
canonicalLevel.text: You can move one additional space when using Dodge. Any time your Evasion reduces damage to 0, you may move as if you Dodged.

canonicalLevel.name: Fighter's Instinct [ Dodge → Skirmish ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Skirmish lets you move 3 spaces before targeting and lets you Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

canonicalLevel.name: Flying Kick [ Jump → Skirmish ]
canonicalLevel.text: If the Skirmish is against one adjacent target, it gains Advantage equal to the number of spaces you moved during your Jump, up to a max of [Talent].

canonicalLevel.name: Wall Jump
canonicalLevel.text: After you end a Jump's movement adjacent to an Obstacle or board edge, you may move an additional 3 spaces in a straight line and gain 1 Evasion. This additional movement is considered part of the Jump's total movement. You can only "Wall Jump" once per Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Weightless Body
canonicalLevel.text: You may "Wall Jump" any number of times in a Jump. You can't use the effect of "Wall Jump" on the same Obstacle or board edge more than once per Jump.

canonicalLevel.name: Draw Stance
canonicalLevel.text: After you Breathe or Charge, you may enter ‘Draw Stance', removing any other Stances you had. This effect ends after you Attack, Stride, or Jump. If you use a Talent Finisher or Skirmish in Draw Stance, you can Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

canonicalLevel.name: Divide In One Motion [ Breathe → Jump ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Jump does not end Draw Stance. After using the Jump, you may use a Talent Finisher at no AP Cost. The Finisher affects all opposing targets you moved into adjacency with or through during your Jump.

canonicalLevel.name: Leaping Koi
canonicalLevel.text: If you use "Divide In One Motion", roll the Finisher before using your Jump's Movement. For every Critical Hit rolled in the Finisher, you may move an additional 3 spaces in a straight line. This additional movement is considered part of the Jump's total movement.

rules.name: План и исполнение
rules.note: Новая цель Изучения заполняет Хитрый план; интерфейс явно предлагает потратить сегмент на Быстрое действие не-Атаки.

canonicalLevel.name: Plan and Execute
canonicalLevel.text: Begin tracking ‘Cunning Plan', a 4 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. If you Investigate a character who you haven't Investigated this Turn, fill one Cunning Plan Segment. Once per Turn, you may empty a Segment to take any non-Attack Action, reducing its Cost by 1 and gaining Swift.

rules.name: Планы внутри планов
rules.note: Снято ограничение одного «Плана и исполнения» за Ход.

canonicalLevel.name: Plans Within Plans
canonicalLevel.text: "Plan and Execute"s spending portion is no longer once per Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: At a Glance
canonicalLevel.text: The first time you Investigate each Turn, you may spend 1 Focus to Swifty Investigate another enemy within [Mind] spaces of the target at no Cost.

rules.name: Пиковая форма
rules.note: Четыре условия заполняют Стиль, попадание очищает сегмент, а полные часы запускают получение ОД и выбор прямого перемещения.

canonicalLevel.name: Peak Condition
canonicalLevel.text: Begin tracking ‘Style', a 4 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. Whenever you Attack, fill one Style Segment for each of the following conditions that it fulfilled. After you take damage from an Attack, empty one. After you fill the Clock, empty it, move up to 2 spaces in a Line, and gain 1 AP. ‣ Drama: Attack rolled 2 or more Critical Hits. ‣ Dance: Previous action moved you Adjacent to target. ‣ Diversify: You didn't use the Attack on your last Turn. ‣ Denouement: Attack brought you to 0 AP.

rules.name: Дразнить, красоваться, устрашать
rules.note: При заполнении Стиля можно отказаться от ОД и выбрать массовый Спровоцирован или Испуган для врагов в пределах 3.

canonicalLevel.name: Dance With Me
canonicalLevel.text: The first time you move each Turn without spending AP, fill one Style Segment.

rules.name: Финал
rules.note: Зарядка предлагает распределить удвоенное Напряжение через любое число заполнений Стиля, разрешает каждый итог и затем отключает Стиль до конца Сцены.

canonicalLevel.name: Finale
canonicalLevel.text: Your attacks that fill at least 2 Style Segments before dice are rolled Crit on a roll of 5 or 6. Once per Scene, when a single Attack fills 4 Style Segments, you may lose the movement and AP gained from "Peak Condition" to deal [Tension + Tier] Damage to the target of the attack instead.

canonicalLevel.name: Hook Shot
canonicalLevel.text: After you Cast targeting a non-adjacent unoccupied space, you may ‘Swing'. When you do, track your distance from the target, and Teleport to any space an equal distance away from the target.

canonicalLevel.name: Draw In
canonicalLevel.text: Before you Cast targeting an opponent, you may choose to have the Cast not deal damage. If you do, the Cast has its Cost reduced to 0, move one space towards them, and pull them one space towards you, repeating until you both can't move any more.

canonicalLevel.name: Momentum [ Cast → Skirmish ]
canonicalLevel.text: If movement provided by your Cast moved you adjacent to the target of your Skirmish, you gain [Tier x 2] Advantage on that Skirmish and you push them 4 spaces.

rules.name: Метнуть
rules.note: Метание тратит 1 Оружие, обнуляет стоимость Стычки и меняет выбор цели и дальность.

canonicalLevel.name: Throw
canonicalLevel.text: You now use ‘Weapons' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with 4 Weapons. Before you Skirmish, you can ‘Throw', spending 1 Weapon, reducing the Skirmish's cost to 0, and letting the Skirmish target one character within 4 range instead of its normal targeting.

rules.name: Пополнение
rules.note: После Метания создаётся маркер Оружия; вход предлагает подобрать его, получить Оружие и переместиться. Незакрыто: канонический выбор свободной смежной клетки вместо клетки цели.

canonicalLevel.name: Resupply
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. After you resolve a Skirmish with Throw, place a ‘Weapon Marker' in the space of your target or an unoccupied space adjacent to it. After you move into a Weapon Marker's space, you may remove it to move 1 space and gain 1 Weapon.

rules.name: Преследователь
rules.note: Выход врага из клетки маркера предлагает телепортацию и оплаченную Быструю Стычку без Метания.

canonicalLevel.name: Chaser
canonicalLevel.text: When an enemy leaves the space of a Weapon Marker, you may Teleport to the marker and Punish them at no Focus cost. The Skirmish from this Punish can't use Throw.

canonicalLevel.name: "Anything You Can Do…"
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Round, after you Dodge or Clash, you gain an ‘Impression' with the same name as the attacker. As an Action with no Cost, you may spend any of your Impressions to use the indicated NPC's Attack as if you were an NPC. All Impressions are lost at the end of a Scene.

canonicalLevel.name: Rehearsed Movements
canonicalLevel.text: After you Dodge an NPC while you hold an Impression matching their name, you gain 2 additional Evasion.

canonicalLevel.name: "…I Can Do Better"
canonicalLevel.text: After you gain an Impression, you may spend 1 Focus to gain that NPCs Passive effect until you spend the Impression.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки
интерфейс и журнал должны объяснять подготовленные последствия

canonicalLevel.name: Trick Weapon
canonicalLevel.text: Choose an acquired Weapon Technique to become your ‘Primary Form'. Choose a Weapon Technique you don't have to make its first 2 Levels into your ‘Secondary Form'. If it has an alternate Foci, track it separately and use it as your Focus in that Form. Start combat in your Primary Form. Before your first Breathe or Charge each Turn, swap Forms, losing any Techniques from your current Form, and gaining the ones attached to the other, triggering any of their new start of Turn / Scene effects. You cannot unlock your Secondary Form's Levels through Tier increases.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки

canonicalLevel.name: Adaptive Edge
canonicalLevel.text: Upgrade your secondary form to level 3. You may Charge at 1 Cost so long as you haven't swapped forms this Turn.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки

canonicalLevel.name: Metalurgy
canonicalLevel.text: Gain a benefit after you swap for the first time each Turn, based on the Archetype of that Form. ‣ Powerhouse: Strengthen and Reinforce yourself. ‣ Vagabond: Strengthen and Hasten yourself. ‣ Bulwark: Reinforce yourself and gain [Body] Evasion. ‣ Altruist: Strengthen allies within [Tier] spaces. ‣ Disruptor: Snare an enemy within [Tier] spaces. ‣ Ruiner: Gain [Spirit] Focus and Steady yourself.

rules.name: На горячем ходу
rules.note: Стоимость в Фокусе повышает Нагрев, получение Фокуса снижает его; порог 6, сброс до 3 и базовый взрыв разрешаются ядром.

canonicalLevel.name: Running Hot
canonicalLevel.text: You now use ‘Heat' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with 0 Heat. Substitute all Focus costs with gaining Heat instead. Effects that would give Focus reduce Heat instead. If your Heat increases to 6 or more, it is reset to 3 and you deal [Mind] damage to yourself and all adjacent enemies.

rules.name: Перегрузка
rules.note: Явный выбор Перегрузки записывает Преимущество, Порчу целей и Нагрев за неуспешные кости после Реакций.

canonicalLevel.name: Overload
canonicalLevel.text: Before you Skirmish or Finisher, you may "Overload", giving it [Mind / 2] Advantage and Blighting the target(s). You receive 1 Heat for every Crit rolled.

rules.name: Разгон
rules.note: Передышка при Напряжении 2+ предлагает Разгон; урон создаёт Нагрев, а взрыв предлагает альтернативное разрешение и перемещение.

canonicalLevel.name: Overclock
canonicalLevel.text: After you Breathe with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Overclock' until the end of your next Turn. While Overclocked, dealing or taking any amount of damage generates 1 Heat. Whenever you would explode while Overclocked, you may instead set your Heat to 3 to take [Mind / 2] damage, move up to 3 spaces, and gain 1 AP.

canonicalLevel.name: Pack Tactics
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Round, when an ally resolves an Attack on a character within [Talent] spaces, you may Swiftly Skirmish at no Cost, targeting them. If you are outside Skirmish's range, you may Teleport to a space adjacent to the target before drawing range.

canonicalLevel.name: Hungry Eyes
canonicalLevel.text: When an ally within [Talent] spaces targets a character with an attack, you may spend 1 Focus to Mark the target.

canonicalLevel.name: Launcher Combo
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Round, when an ally inflicts an Effect to an enemy within [Talent] spaces, you may use the effect "Pack Tactics" on the same target. This level has a separate once per Round limitation from the one in "Pack Tactics".

canonicalLevel.name: Catch The Blade
canonicalLevel.text: At the beginning of your Turn, you may name any number and note it down until the end of the Scene. If an enemy's attack would deal damage to you equal to a number noted (this includes 0), gain [Mind] Evasion before the damage is dealt.

canonicalLevel.name: Watch And Wait
canonicalLevel.text: Whenever you take damage from an enemy, you may note another number with "Catch The Blade". Enemies who attack you cannot roll additional dice with their Critical Hits.

canonicalLevel.name: To Carry Their Fury
canonicalLevel.text: After you reduce an attack's damage to 0 with Evasion, you may teleport adjacent to the attacker and Swiftly Skirmish them at no cost. After you make an attack and deal damage equal to a number you noted, you may remove any of your noted numbers to deal two additional damage for each removed.

rules.name: Изучить слабость
rules.note: Повторное и третье Изучение получают Быстроту по тексту уровня; после Изучения можно поставить привязанную к цели Слабую точку, а Атака с её клетки снимает маркер, становится Быстрой и использует Разум.

canonicalLevel.name: Study Weakness
canonicalLevel.text: After you Investigate a character, place a ‘Weak Point' in a space adjacent to them that doesn't have one. Your Investigations that target the same character are Swift this Turn. Weak Points move to match their host's movement. After you move into a Weak Point, you may remove it to ‘Jab', dealing [Mind/2] damage to its host. This counts as a Swift Skirmish, but cannot have its damage or targeting altered.

review.correction: Исправлен усечённый digest; canonical EN payload теперь идентифицируется полным SHA-256.

rules.name: Полевая разведка
rules.note: Промах вражеской Атаки предлагает бесплатное Быстрое Изучение атакующего; снятие Слабой точки автоматически даёт 2 Уклонения.

canonicalLevel.name: Dissect [ Investigate x 3 ]
canonicalLevel.text: The third Investigate has no Cost, and Slows all Marked Enemies.

canonicalLevel.name: 4-Point Execution
canonicalLevel.text: Whenever you move, you may teleport to a space an equal number of spaces away, so long as the teleport targets a Weak Point. After you remove 3 Weak Points from one target in a single Turn, you may teleport to any space adjacent to them and perform a Mind Finisher at no cost.

canonicalLevel.name: Down The Hatch
canonicalLevel.text: Establish which direction is "up" after Deploying. After you Breathe, you may ‘Drink', Slowing yourself. Once per Turn, if you start or end your Turn while Slowed you must roll a d6, and move one space in a Line based on the result: 1: Up, 2: Right, 3: Down, 4: Left, 5/6: Any direction. When involuntary movement moves you adjacent to, out of adjacency with, or have your movement prevented by an enemy, you may deal [Tier] damage to them, up to once per type of trigger per enemy per Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Fool's Dance
canonicalLevel.text: If you end your Turn while Slowed, gain Evasion equal to [Tier/2] + the number of Negative Effects on you.

canonicalLevel.name: Chug
canonicalLevel.text: The first Breathe on your Turn is Swift. After you Drink while Slowed,you Shred, Weaken, and Blight yourself. If you have 3 or more Negative Effects at once, you may ignore the effects of each. The movement from "Down The Hatch" can now trigger with any Negative Effect, and when triggered with two or more Effects it changes to "twice per Turn".

rules.name: Многогранность
rules.note: Вооружение выбирается вместе со Стычкой; ядро проверяет дистанцию, число целей и повторное экипирование, хранит взаимоисключающий режим, затем ведёт перемещение, Эффекты и толчок. Каждое Вооружение ограничено одним разом за Ход.

canonicalLevel.name: Multi-Faceted
canonicalLevel.text: Gain the three following ‘Armaments'. Each one has a condition, and if you Skirmish while that condition is fulfilled you ‘Equip' it, replacing any Armament you had Equipped before. Each Armament can only be Equipped once per Turn. ‣ Blade: Skirmish while exactly 2 spaces away from an enemy and adjacent to none. This Skirmish is Swift. Before targeting, move one space. After resolving the Skirmish, Strengthen yourself. ‣ Pole: Skirmish 2 adjacent enemies. This Skirmish is Swift, and pushes your targets 3 spaces away from you. After resolving the Skirmish, Launch your targets. ‣ Chain: Skirmish while exactly 4 spaces from your intended Target. This Skirmish is Swift and can choose a target 4 spaces away from you. After resolving the Skirmish, Shred your target .

rules.name: Как вода
rules.note: Второе экипирование за Ход автоматически даёт 1 ОД и Ускорен.

canonicalLevel.name: Like Water
canonicalLevel.text: The 2nd time you Equip an Armament each Turn, you gain 1 AP and Hasten yourself.

rules.name: Мастер за работой
rules.note: Только Завершение Талантом читает текущее авторитетное Вооружение: Клинок проверяет путь до 2 клеток, Древко строит Линию длиной 2, а Цепь строит 1×1 и расширяет её по проверенным Критам.

canonicalLevel.name: Master At Work
canonicalLevel.text: If you use a Talent Finisher while you have an Armament Equipped, you gain a bonus based on the Armament. ‣ Blade: Move two spaces ignoring characters. If you passed through the Finisher's Target, Mark and Launch them. ‣ Pole: This Finisher targets a 2 space Line drawn from your space. If this Finisher Spikes a Launched character, it gains an additional [Tier] Advantage and the spaces you targeted become Difficult Terrain. ‣ Chain: This Finisher targets all enemies in a 1x1 Zone centered on a space adjacent to you. For each Critical Hit you roll, that Zone expands by 1 space in every direction (1x1 > 3x3 > 5x5...) and deals one additional damage.

canonicalLevel.name: 30,000 Tons
canonicalLevel.text: Before you Skirmish, you may ‘Brace', making the Skirmish target no characters, Reinforcing yourself, and Taunting all adjacent enemies. If you Skirmish while Reinforced, you ‘Slam', dealing [Tension] additional damage and losing Reinforced.

canonicalLevel.name: Hammerfall
canonicalLevel.text: If you Slam after taking at least 5 damage before reductions since the end of your last Turn, you target all spaces adjacent to you instead of your normal targeting and Weaken all targets.

canonicalLevel.name: "You Look Like A Nail"
canonicalLevel.text: If you Slam after taking at least 10 damage (before reductions) since the end of your last Turn, you deal an additional [Body] damage.

rules.name: Огромные руки
rules.note: Зона, оплата и общий конвейер Атаки поддержаны; замена цели конкретного Завершения Телом ещё не связана атомарно.

canonicalLevel.name: Big Arms
canonicalLevel.text: Before you use a Body Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to have it target each character in a 2x2 Zone adjacent to you.

canonicalLevel.name: Immense
canonicalLevel.text: Gain [Body] additional maximum Health. You may take up a 2x2 section of spaces rather than one space when you Deploy. If you do so, you may freely move through 1x1 enemies and Obstacles.

canonicalLevel.name: Shockwave
canonicalLevel.text: Before you use a Body Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to have it target all spaces adjacent to you, deal half damage, and have it Launch its targets.

canonicalLevel.name: Tough As Stone
canonicalLevel.text: You can never have a Speed lower than 3 and can always move using your own Actions, ignoring all other rules to the contrary.

rules.name: Выносливость
rules.note: Броня автоматически включает [Тело / 2].

canonicalLevel.name: Resilience
canonicalLevel.text: Gain [Body/2] Armor.

canonicalLevel.name: Stainless Stride
canonicalLevel.text: At the beginning of your Turn, you may Immobilize yourself. While Immobilized, you can never take more damage than 4 + [Tier/2] in one instance (after all forms of damage reduction).

canonicalLevel.name: White Knight
canonicalLevel.text: You may Block Attacks that target allies within [Body] spaces. When you do so, you Teleport to a space adjacent to the target and become the target instead.

canonicalLevel.name: Steel Angel
canonicalLevel.text: The first Block you use each Round has no Focus cost and gives you [Tier] Armor after the Attack resolves until the start of your next Turn, if you're Blocking for your allies.

canonicalLevel.name: Inspire Courage
canonicalLevel.text: After you start movement by moving out of adjacency with an ally, they may move to a space adjacent to your new location and Reinforce.

canonicalLevel.name: Easy To Hate
canonicalLevel.text: Gain 3 Focus at the start of each Scene. After you Investigate an enemy, you may spend 1 Focus to Taunt them.

canonicalLevel.name: Bully
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Turn, after you Taunt a character, you may move up to 3 spaces towards them. If you move into adjacency with them, Snare them and gain 1 AP.

canonicalLevel.name: Add Injury To Insult
canonicalLevel.text: Your Attacks against characters you've Taunted gain [Tier/2] Advantage.

canonicalLevel.name: Trusty Steed
canonicalLevel.text: After Deploying, you may Summon a Mount NPC with a Tier equal to yours adjacent to you.

canonicalLevel.name: Grasping Jaws
canonicalLevel.text: After your Mount attacks an enemy, you may have it Taunt them.

canonicalLevel.name: Roaring Entry
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Scene for 1 AP, you may have your Mount "Roar". When it Roars, it Dazes enemies in 3 spaces of it, pushing them 2 spaces.

canonicalLevel.name: Restrain
canonicalLevel.text: After you Body Finisher, Snare your target. Characters you have Snared also count as being Taunted by you.

rules.name: Перелом позвоночника
rules.note: Стычки получают 1 Преимущество. Для единственной Подброшенной цели можно выбрать составной модификатор: Вбить, телепортироваться в свободную смежную клетку и заменить Атаку на Завершение Телом по исходной Стоимости.

canonicalLevel.name: Spine Breaker
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. If you would Spike a single Launched character, you may teleport to a space adjacent to your target and change the attack you are using into a Body Finisher at no Cost.

canonicalLevel.name: Finishing Move [ Body Finisher → Jump ]
canonicalLevel.text: Instead of moving with this Jump, you and a target of the Finisher Disappear. At the start of the next round or when either of you're able to take another Action (whatever comes first) you both return to the board in the same spaces, Launching all other enemies in 2 range, and letting you Swiftly Body Finisher the initial target at no cost.

canonicalLevel.name: Wild Charge
canonicalLevel.text: Before you Jump, you may move [Body] spaces instead of [Talent], may deal 30 damage to any Obstacles you move adjacent to, and move any number of characters you passed through or moved into adjacency with to a space adjacent to you.

canonicalLevel.name: Violence
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Round, after you move through characters using "Wild Charge", you may deal [Body / 2] damage to them and Launch one of them.

canonicalLevel.name: "Eat Dirt!"
canonicalLevel.text: After you Launch an adjacent character without Attacking, you may ‘Throw' them, moving them 5 spaces in any direction. If they end their movement adjacent to another character or Obstacle, deal [Body] damage to both and remove Launched from them.

canonicalLevel.name: Lash
canonicalLevel.text: When an ally is hit by an Attack, you may spend 1 Focus to Swiftly Cast, targeting the attacker regardless of range at no AP Cost (this cannot trigger Lash or have you Cast targeting yourself).

canonicalLevel.name: Loving Rite
canonicalLevel.text: When an ally is damaged, you may take [Tier] damage to reduce the amount they took by [Tier]. After you trigger this because an ally was attacked, you may Fear the Attacker.

canonicalLevel.name: Devotion
canonicalLevel.text: When you trigger "Loving Rite" and no other allies are Marked by you, you may Mark them. When you trigger "Lash" with an ally you've Marked, you may use a Finisher instead of Cast. Joel's Notes: Using Summons If you're creating a character who can use Summons or NPC actions it's important to familiarize yourself with the Narrator-side NPC rules on page 108.

rules.name: Чего не хватает Духу
rules.note: Общий запас оплачивает Фокус и ОД, округляет [Тело / 2] вверх, сбрасывается в начале Раунда; Передышка и Зарядка не пополняют его.

canonicalLevel.name: For What The Spirit Lacks
canonicalLevel.text: You now use ‘Tenacity' instead of Focus or AP, spending it in place of both. You start each Round of combat with 2 Tenacity + [Body / 2]. You can't gain Tenacity from anything other than this Technique. You can't use Cast or Spirit Finishers.

rules.name: Копнуть глубже, стоять твердо
rules.note: Получение предложения Реакции как цели Атаки даёт 1 Упорство.

canonicalLevel.name: Dig Deep, Stand Firm
canonicalLevel.text: After you're the target of an Attack, gain 1 Tenacity. When you would gain Focus, you reduce the cost of your first Finisher that Round by the same amount (this includes the initial AP cost as well as any additional cost added that would normally be paid with Focus).

rules.name: Перед лицом Запредельного
rules.note: Передышка и Зарядка принимают явный список целей Спровоцированного в пределах 4 и ограничивают его несостоявшимся получением Фокуса.

canonicalLevel.name: In The Face Of The Beyond
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Scene, after you target an adjacent enemy, you may spend 2 Tenacity to ‘Silence' them. Silenced characters can only move or Attack on their Turn, and their Attacks cannot apply or trigger any feature or effect other than damage. Enemies you Silence remain Silenced until they end their Turn outside of adjacency with you, or until the end of the Round (whatever happens first).

canonicalLevel.name: Perfect Deflection
canonicalLevel.text: After you perform a successful Clash, you gain 1 Focus and can move [Tier] spaces.

canonicalLevel.name: "You'll Have To Get Through Me!"
canonicalLevel.text: You may Clash with Attacks that target allies within [Spirit] spaces. Before you Clash, you may Teleport to a space adjacent to the character who initiated the attack.

rules.name: Драма и злость
rules.note: В бросок Столкновения автоматически добавляются 3 кости.

canonicalLevel.name: Drama And Spite
canonicalLevel.text: Gain 2 Advantage in Clashes. Your Spirit counts as being 2 higher while in Clashes

canonicalLevel.name: Wall
canonicalLevel.text: Before you Block, you may spend 1 Focus to gain [Tier / 2] additional Armor, and retain the Armor until you take another reaction, or you start your Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Shield Charge
canonicalLevel.text: After you Block, place a ‘Shield Marker' in a space adjacent to you until you create another one. The Shield Marker moves to match your movement. If your movement would move your Shield Marker into an opponent's space, you may remove the Marker to deal [Body] damage to them and push them 2 spaces.

canonicalLevel.name: Focused Defense
canonicalLevel.text: While you have a Shield Marker, indicate a 3×3 Zone centered on it. If an attack would resolve against you while the attacker is inside that Zone, they're Weakened for the duration of the Attack.

canonicalLevel.name: Guardian
canonicalLevel.text: So long as you haven't moved during your Turn, the spaces diagonally surrounding you count as being adjacent when it would benefit you.

rules.name: На посту
rules.note: Выход врага из смежности открывает Наказание с обычной оплатой либо очисткой Бдительности; бросок, Реакции и отмена проходят через общий конвейер.

canonicalLevel.name: On Watch
canonicalLevel.text: Begin tracking ‘Vigilance', a 4 Segment Clock that's filled at the start of every Scene. You may empty one Segment of this Clock when using Punish to have it not cost Focus. After you Charge, you refill the Vigilance Clock.

canonicalLevel.name: Zone Of Influence
canonicalLevel.text: After you Investigate, you may place up to 4 ‘Spotlights' in unoccupied spaces on the board. A Spotlight is a unique piece of Difficult Terrain that only affects enemies. When an enemy enters a Spotlight, you may teleport to an adjacent space and Punish them as if they left adjacency with you.

canonicalLevel.name: Beastly
canonicalLevel.text: Choose two NPC Types. Once per Scene, after you Charge or Awaken this with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', pushing all enemies within 2 range 3 spaces away and restoring [Body x 2] Health. While Transformed you can use your NPCs' Attacks, said Attacks lose any additional damage from Tension. After you're reduced to 0 Health while Transformed, it ends, and you're Dazed.

canonicalLevel.name: Inheritance
canonicalLevel.text: Choose one of the two NPCs you chose when gaining "Beastly". You gain that NPC's Passive while Transformed, and use their on Deploy effects when you Transform. If the Passive triggers when the user is Knocked Out, it triggers after you end your Transformation instead.

canonicalLevel.name: Apex
canonicalLevel.text: While you're Transformed you can use your NPCs' Actions by spending 1 AP. If you're Tier 3 or higher, you may Daze yourself and spend 2 Focus to transform as soon as you deploy regardless of Tension.

canonicalLevel.name: Two Bodies
canonicalLevel.text: You can Block when other characters are attacked, granting that character any Armor you would gain and preventing any forced movement they'd receive. When you would Block for an ally without a ‘Guardian' marker, first create one in a space within [Spirit] range. Unless the Guardian is adjacent to the attacker or the target when you Block, the Block is canceled. If you move while you have a Guardian you may move them the same distance.

canonicalLevel.name: Together In Life
canonicalLevel.text: Allies who start their Turn adjacent to or in the Guardian's space are Reinforced, enemies who do the same are Marked.

canonicalLevel.name: Together In Death
canonicalLevel.text: Your Blocks for allies have their focus cost reduced to 1 and gives [spirit] armor instead of [body].

canonicalLevel.name: Rune Core Engine
canonicalLevel.text: Once per scene, when you attack an enemy you may Summon your ‘Mech' to assist you, making the attack deal [Tier] additional damage and placing it adjacent to the target, with it pushing any characters in its space adjacent to it or as close as possible. The Mech is a 2x2 NPC with no Type, 15 Health, and [Tier/2] Armor that cannot take Turns. By Interacting with it, you ‘Pilot' it. This removes the NPC, grants you [Tier/2] Armor, and makes your character 2x2 in size. You may use Interact again to leave, losing these benefits and placing the Obstacle adjacent to you in sufficient empty spaces.

canonicalLevel.name: Autonomous
canonicalLevel.text: The Mech can now take Turns and is changed to a non- Modifier NPC of your choice with a Tier equal to yours and a minimum of [Tier/2] armor. While your Summon takes its Turn, you may Skirmish a character adjacent to it (regardless of range) in place of one of its Attacks.

canonicalLevel.name: Perfect Sync
canonicalLevel.text: You may start scenes Piloting. Even while you are in the Suit, it may still take Turns as a Summon, sharing your space and moving you when it moves. While you are in the Suit, the Summon is Dazed.

canonicalLevel.name: Flash Of Insight
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Round, after any Roll from an enemy or willing ally, you may spend 1 Focus to force its initiator to redo it.

canonicalLevel.name: Take Advantage
canonicalLevel.text: When using "Flash Of Insight" against an enemy's Attack, the attack's target gains [Mind/2] Evasion.

canonicalLevel.name: Watch And Wait
canonicalLevel.text: After you investigate an enemy, you may spend 2 additional Focus to ‘Predict' them. The GM must tell you what actions they plan to use and the targets, if applicable. If that enemy does not take the action(s) described on their Turn, they are Dazed and Weakened at the end of their Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Strike Order
canonicalLevel.text: After you mark a character, an ally of your choosing may move up to 3 spaces towards the character. Your Investigates are Swift.

canonicalLevel.name: Teaching Moment
canonicalLevel.text: When an ally is dealt a Wound, you may Investigate the character who Wounded them at no Cost as a Reaction.

canonicalLevel.name: Remember Your Training
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Turn per ally, when an ally moves adjacent to an enemy through the movement given by "Strike Order", you may have them deal their [Body/2] or [Talent/2] Damage to said enemy.

rules.name: Успокаивающая аура
rules.note: В начале Хода союзника стол предлагает снять один выбранный Эффект и наложить Усилен.

canonicalLevel.name: Calming Aura
canonicalLevel.text: Allies who start their Turn adjacent to you may lose any one of their Effects and become Strengthened.

rules.name: Защитный отклик
rules.note: После внешней Раны или Эффекта стол предлагает бесплатный Прорыв в смежную клетку.

canonicalLevel.name: Protective Response
canonicalLevel.text: When an ally within [Talent] spaces takes a Wound or Effect from a source other than themself, you may Break Out at no Influence cost so long as it moves you adjacent to them.

rules.name: Ты в порядке?
rules.note: На начале Хода союзника рядом адаптер ядра автоматически даёт 3 Фокуса и восстанавливает [Ступень] Здоровья; отдельный платный Support-путь удалён, чтобы исключить двойное применение.

canonicalLevel.name: "Are You Ok?"
canonicalLevel.text: Allies who start their Turn next to you gain 3 Focus and restore [Tier] Health.

review.correction: Registry переведён в passive/full; оставлен boundary adapter 3 Focus + [Tier] Health, платный Support путь исключён.

rules.name: Сила молитвы
rules.note: Вера начинается с Духа, не пополняется Передышкой/Зарядкой и растёт при выборе союзника целью.

canonicalLevel.name: Strength Of Prayer
canonicalLevel.text: You now use ‘Compassion' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with [Spirit] Compassion. You can't gain Compassion using Breathe or Charge. You gain 1 Compassion after you target an ally with an action or the effect of a Technique.

rules.name: Очищающий свет
rules.note: Заклинание по союзникам использует лечебное разрешение и явный выбор снимаемых Эффектов.

canonicalLevel.name: Cleansing Light
canonicalLevel.text: If you Cast targeting an ally, you don't deal damage or Negative Effects. Instead, heal [Hits] Health to your target(s), and have all Effects of their choice removed from them.

rules.name: Великое восстановление
rules.note: Завершение Духом наследует лечение, даёт Регенерацию и один раз за Сцену снимает Рану цели.

canonicalLevel.name: Grand Restoration
canonicalLevel.text: Your Spirit Finisher gains the effects of "Cleansing Light", and can target characters within 5 range. When using a Spirit Finisher on an ally, they begin Regenerating and lose a Wound (Wounds can only be healed once per character per Scene).

canonicalLevel.name: Healthy Meal
canonicalLevel.text: You have [Mind / 2] ‘Meals' that refresh each Intermission. You may Interact to hand an adjacent ally a Meal, and Reinforce or Hasten them. When this Effect expires, the character finishes their meal, and restores 4 + [Mind] Health.

rules.name: Бездонная кладовая
rules.note: Запас Трапез автоматически равен 3 за Интермиссию.

canonicalLevel.name: Fast Food
canonicalLevel.text: After you move out of adjacency with an ally, you may give them a Meal without Interacting.

canonicalLevel.name: Shared Experiences
canonicalLevel.text: When someone you're Bonded with eats one of your Meals, you both gain [Mind] Focus.

rules.name: Не навреди
rules.note: Смежный союзник, стоимость и округлённое вверх лечение работают, но ядро принимает готовые successes и не доказывает обязательный бросок Разума.

canonicalLevel.name: Do No Harm
canonicalLevel.text: If you Skirmish an ally, you may ‘Operate' on them. When you Operate you must roll Mind instead of Talent or Body, and your target restores [Hits / 2] Health rather than taking Damage.

canonicalLevel.name: Operational Procedure
canonicalLevel.text: After you take this feature or after you take an Intermission, lose any ‘Bandages' or ‘Disinfectant', then roll [Mind / 2]. For every odd number rolled, gain one Bandage. For every even number rolled, gain one Disinfectant. After you Operate you may expend a Bandage to heal a Wound, and/or a Disinfectant to remove any number of Effects.

canonicalLevel.name: Miracle Worker
canonicalLevel.text: Gain 3 Advantage on your "Do No Harm" Skirmishes. If you roll two or more 1s or two or more 6s with "Operational Procedure", you may replace the resources gained by those dice with a ‘Miracle'. When an ally is Knocked Out, place a marker where they were. After you Skirmish targeting this Marker, you may expend a Miracle to bring the Knocked Out character back to that space, or an adjacent one if it's occupied, with full Health and 2 Wounds.

canonicalLevel.name: Stop And Think
canonicalLevel.text: Anytime you are Weakened you enter the ‘Tactician Stance', removing any other Stances you had. While in the Tactician Stance, when your non-Attack Actions and Effects you apply deal damage, gain 1 Focus, up to [Mind] times per Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Study
canonicalLevel.text: After you Breathe, you may Weaken yourself to gain 2 additional Focus.

canonicalLevel.name: Eureka!
canonicalLevel.text: After you start your Turn in Tactician Stance, you gain 1 additional AP, and your first attack on this Turn costs 1 more AP.

canonicalLevel.name: Sacred Seal
canonicalLevel.text: If you Breathe, you may replace its effect with placing a ‘Talisman' on an adjacent target. Spaces and characters with Talismans are always valid targets for your Casts, and after you Cast targeting them, you gain 1 Focus.

canonicalLevel.name: Tossed Talisman
canonicalLevel.text: When using "Sacred Seal" you may place Talismans on targets within 5 spaces. After you Charge or Awaken this, you may activate "Sacred Seal" and repeat the effect once for each Focus you would have gained.

canonicalLevel.name: Exorcize
canonicalLevel.text: Your Spirit Finisher can affect all targets with Talismans at once. Doing this destroys your Talismans and gives you 2 Focus for each.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки
интерфейс и журнал должны объяснять подготовленные последствия

canonicalLevel.name: Barrier
canonicalLevel.text: If you Cast targeting one or more allies, you don't deal damage or Negative Effects. Instead, Reinforce them and create a ‘Barrier' between one of them and a space adjacent. Barriers are 5 + [Tier x 5] Health walls that move to match allies they were created for, and do not affect the targeting or movement of allies. After you create a Barrier it replaces all other Barriers.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки

canonicalLevel.name: Impenetrable
canonicalLevel.text: After you create a Barrier, extend it one space in both directions and give [Spirit / 2] Evasion to all allies adjacent to it.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки
