canonicalLevel.name: Block Beam
canonicalLevel.text: After your Barrier would be removed or replaced for any reason, it ‘Fires' away from the character it was created for, dealing [Spirit] damage to all enemies in an infinitely long orthogonal Line.

rules.name: Быстрая смесь
rules.note: Передышка опционально создаёт один из канонических типов; Взаимодействие проверяет запас и дальность, а Чистая вода выбирает любое подмножество Эффектов до оплаты и расхода Зелья.

canonicalLevel.name: Quick Mix
canonicalLevel.text: After you Breathe, you can make one of the following ‘Potions'. You can Interact to use one of these Potions on yourself or a character within 4 range. 1: Pure Water: Remove any Effect(s) from the target. 2: Fury Vapors: Strengthen the target. 3: Growth Serum: Begin Regenerating the target. 4: Adrenaline Stim: Hasten the target. 5: Stoneskin Balm: Reinforce the target. 6: Vilethorn Poison: Blight the target.

rules.name: Мощная смесь
rules.note: Союзник автоматически получает ceil(Разум/2) Фокуса; для врага после фактического использования Зелья открывается перепроверяемый выбор нанести Разум урона или отказаться.

canonicalLevel.name: Powerful Mix
canonicalLevel.text: The first Interact you use on your Turn has its Cost reduced to 0. After you use a potion on an ally, they gain [Mind / 2] Focus. After you use a potion on an enemy, you may deal [Mind] damage to them.

canonicalLevel.name: High Intensity Mix
canonicalLevel.text: If you Breathe, you may replace its effects by triggering "Quick Mix" two more times, randomly determining each potion by rolling a D6, rather than choosing.

canonicalLevel.name: Dance Partner
canonicalLevel.text: You can Interact with a willing character to set them as your ‘Partner'. You may only have one Partner and lose them if you end your Turn outside of adjacency. When one Partner moves willingly, the other may move to a space adjacent to them and gain Haste.

canonicalLevel.name: Hearts In Tandem
canonicalLevel.text: The first time a Partner Hides, or gains Focus each Turn, their partner gains any positive Effects or Focus they gained.

canonicalLevel.name: The Prestige
canonicalLevel.text: When a Partner uses a Finisher, their Partner may Daze themselves to have the finisher crit on rolls of 5 or 6, Teleport adjacent to the target, and use a Skirmish / Cast on the target. Using this effect makes the user lose their Partner status.

canonicalLevel.name: Blowing Smoke
canonicalLevel.text: After you Breathe on your Turn, you may replace its effect with creating ‘Fog' in a space adjacent to you. At the end of your Turn, move your Fog up to 2 spaces in any direction. If you or an ally starts their Turn in Fog, they may Disappear. When a character Disappeared through this level reappears, they must do so in Fog, or as close as possible.

canonicalLevel.name: Mystic Mist
canonicalLevel.text: When a character reappears in Fog, they gain [Mind] Evasion and move up to 3 spaces.

canonicalLevel.name: Stinging Steam
canonicalLevel.text: Your Breaths are Swift. If you Stride you may replace its effect with moving your Fog Clouds up to 2 spaces and deal 2 damage to enemies every time a Fog Cloud passes through them.

canonicalLevel.name: Notably Absent
canonicalLevel.text: You may Assist at the start of any combat Scene regardless of your character's condition. If you Break Out while Assisting allies, you may give them an Effect based on the Action taken. The actions and effects are as follows: ‣ Stride: Hasten. ‣ Breathe: Reinforce. ‣ Investigate: Strengthened.

canonicalLevel.name: Heroic Return
canonicalLevel.text: At the start or end of any Turn where the Tension is 4 or higher, you may return to the board from your Assisting on any border space. After you return to the board, you gain all Positive Effects your allies have. These Effects can't be removed until combat ends.

canonicalLevel.name: Explosive Return
canonicalLevel.text: As soon as you return to the board, you may take a Turn, even if it would interrupt the Turn of an enemy. If this interrupted an ally's Turn, you must wait for them to finish.

canonicalLevel.name: Echo Form
canonicalLevel.text: If you Cast targeting only an ally or yourself, you don't deal damage or negative Effects. Instead, create an ‘Echo' adjacent to them. Echos are targetable pieces of Difficult Terrain with 1 Health. A character with an Echo may draw range from their Echos. You can only make 1 + [Tier] Echos at a time.

canonicalLevel.name: Symmetry
canonicalLevel.text: When a character with an Echo moves, they may move their Echo an equal number of spaces.

canonicalLevel.name: Full Sync
canonicalLevel.text: Characters with an Echo start the Round with 1 additional AP per Echo they have. Characters benefiting from this give Swift to their Attacks, so long as each draws its range from a different Echo.

canonicalLevel.name: Accelerate
canonicalLevel.text: If you Cast targeting an ally, you don't deal damage or Negative Effects. Instead, they may move spaces equal to the damage you would have dealt, and then Hasten them.

rules.name: Замедление
rules.note: Заклинания получают 1 Преимущество; удаление Эффекта открывает перепроверяемое окно повторного применения за 1 Фокус.

canonicalLevel.name: Decelerate
canonicalLevel.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. After you or an ally lose an Effect, you may spend 1 Focus to apply the same effect again.

rules.name: Остановка времени
rules.note: Полный Поток в начале Хода предлагает однократное массовое Заклинание, тратит все ОД и поддерживает Ва-банк с Раной и Завершением против врагов.

canonicalLevel.name: Time Stop
canonicalLevel.text: Begin tracking ‘Flux', an 8 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. After you apply an Effect to an ally, fill one Flux Segment. Once per Scene, after you start your Turn with a full Flux Clock, you may spend all your AP to empty it and Cast, targeting all characters in the Scene. If there are two or fewer enemies, you may take a Wound to go All Out and turn your roll against them into a Finisher.

canonicalLevel.name: Musician
canonicalLevel.text: After you Breathe, gain a ‘Verse' of your choice from the list below. You can hold up to 4 Verses at a time (Including repeated verses). After you use Charge, you may expend all the Verses you are holding and grant the effects listed on them to characters in a 3x3 Zone placed adjacent to you. ‣ Harsh: Allies Strengthen and may move 1 space. ‣ Soothing: Allies gain [Mind / 2] Health. ‣ Inspiring: Hasten and give 1 Focus to allies. ‣ Raucous: Shred and deal 1 damage to enemies. ‣ Frantic: Allies may use a 1 Cost Utility action for free.

canonicalLevel.name: Reverb
canonicalLevel.text: Your Breaths are Swift. After you gain a Verse, you may immediately perform its effect on adjacent characters without spending it.

canonicalLevel.name: Encore
canonicalLevel.text: If you Charge with 3 or more Verses, you may forgo the Focus given to reduce its cost to 1.

canonicalLevel.name: Stroke Of The Brush
canonicalLevel.text: You can Interact to ‘Paint' on an adjacent space in a ‘Color' of your choice. Each Color has a specific effect that triggers after you or an ally enters its space or starts their Turn in it for the first time in a Round. The Colors are as follows. ‣ Red: Strengthen yourself. ‣ Yellow: Teleport to another Colored space. ‣ Blue: Gain 2 Focus. ‣ White: Push any enemies in 3 spaces 3 spaces. ‣ Black: Pull any enemies in 5 spaces adjacent to you.

canonicalLevel.name: Canvas Of Flesh
canonicalLevel.text: The first Interact you use on your Turn has its Cost reduced to 0. After you Interact with an ally, you may spend 3 Focus to create a ‘Seal' on them, letting them gain the effect of one of your Colors every time they end their Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Brush-Brand
canonicalLevel.text: After you Skirmish a character, you may ‘Brand' them with a Color of your choice. After you or an ally Attack a Branded character, consume the Brand and the attacker triggers the effect of the Color.

canonicalLevel.name: Draw
canonicalLevel.text: After deploying, roll a die and set it aside. These dice are your ‘Cards'. After you Breathe with three or fewer Cards, roll a new Card. Before you Cast, you may spend any of your Cards to roll [Mind] instead of [Spirit], have it deal no damage to allies, and gain the Card's bonus. The bonuses for each are as follows: 1: Illness: Blights and permanently Slows the Target. 2: Star: Restore Focus equal to the damage dealt. 3: Night: The target Disappears and becomes Invisible. 4: Protection: Permanently Reinforces the target. 5: Union: Snare the target, Teleport adjacent to them. 6: Folly: Dazes, Immobilizes, and Launches the target.

canonicalLevel.name: Card Capture
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Scene, after you Investigate an NPC's Attack, you can roll a Card with all of that attack's non-damage effects. At the end of the scene, you can replace a Card in your deck with that Card. You can only replace up to 3 of your Cards like this at a time, and can return your default Cards at any time.

canonicalLevel.name: Greed
canonicalLevel.text: "Draw" has you roll double the Cards in all scenarios, and you may gain Cards by Breathing when at or below 5 cards instead of 3.

rules.name: Пламя духовного плетения
rules.note: Изученный тип Духа сохраняется в листе и импорте; первая Зарядка создаёт Пламя, а Атака по его клетке обязательно толкает маркер на 1.

canonicalLevel.name: Spirit Weaving Flame
canonicalLevel.text: After you Charge for the first time in a scene, you may create a "Spirit Flame" within 1 space of you, a marker that you can move up to 4 spaces after you Stride or end your Turn. It's pushed 1 space when its space, or a character in its space, is the target of an attack. When a character is standing on, or adjacent to your Spirit Flame, they count as having an effect. Choose an option from the list below to determine the effect: ‣ Dreamy Spirit: Enemies are Slowed. ‣ Angry Spirit: Enemies are Blighted. ‣ Insightful Spirit: Enemies are Marked. ‣ Intense Spirit: Allies are Hasted. ‣ Kind Spirit: Allies are Regenerating. ‣ Violent Spirit: Allies are Strengthened.

rules.name: Дружелюбные духи
rules.note: Дружественный выход предлагает переместить Пламя; вражеский путь прерывается на первой клетке выхода до downstream enter-триггеров и продолжается только после перепроверяемого отказа.

canonicalLevel.name: Friendly Spirits
canonicalLevel.text: When an ally moves out of your Spirit Flame, you may have it move to a space adjacent to their new position. When an enemy attempts to move out of your Spirit Flame, you may spend 1 Focus to stop their movement after they move out of that space, leaving them adjacent to the Spirit Flame.

rules.name: Парные духи
rules.note: Второй изученный тип сохраняется; поддерживаются одно Пламя с двумя свойствами либо два независимых Пламени с отдельными эффектами и движением.

canonicalLevel.name: Twinned Spirits
canonicalLevel.text: You may choose an additional option from "Spirit Weaving Flame". If you create a Spirit Flame you may create two, one of each type, or create one with the properties of both.

canonicalLevel.name: Bleeding Edge
canonicalLevel.text: Your successful Skirmishes and Talent Finishers Blight the target(s).

canonicalLevel.name: Bloodhound
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When a non-adjacent enemy takes damage from Blight, move up to 3 spaces. If it brings you adjacent, you may remove the Blight to Swift Skirmish them at no cost.

canonicalLevel.name: Rupture [ Skirmish → Breathe ]
canonicalLevel.text: If the Skirmish's target was Blighted, roll Talent and trigger the effect of Blight [Hits] times.

canonicalLevel.name: Sublimation
canonicalLevel.text: Your Improvises have their Cost set to 1 and can create an Obstacle up to 4 spaces away. When resolving an action targeting an Obstacle, you may destroy it to create a 3×3 Zone of ‘Gas' centered on its space that disappears at the start of your next Turn. When an enemy enters Gas, they are Weakened. Allies in the Gas gain 3 Evasion when they're the target of an Attack coming from outside the Gas.

rules.name: Экспериментальная смесь
rules.note: Незакрыто: опциональный запрос Нарратору о скрытом Здоровье; текущий автоматический KO не может заменять это решение.

canonicalLevel.name: Experimental Mixture
canonicalLevel.text: After you Weaken a character, you may ask the Narrator what its current Health is. If its at or below [Mind], that character is Knocked Out and you gain 2 Focus.

canonicalLevel.name: Deposition
canonicalLevel.text: After you create a Gas Zone, deal [Mind] damage to all enemies in the spaces it covers. After you Knock Out an enemy with "Experimental Mixture", create a 3x3 Gas Zone centered on them.

rules.name: Обвить
rules.note: Успешная одиночная Стычка накладывает Пойман; движение источника предлагает притянуть цели, а конец Хода — по очереди переместить их на расстояние до 5 клеток.

canonicalLevel.name: Wrap
canonicalLevel.text: Your Successful Skirmishes with 1 target Snare the target. At the end of your Turn, you can move all characters you've Snared up to 5 spaces. You do not need to pull characters you've Snared after you move.

rules.name: Удушение
rules.note: Завершения Телом и Талантом игнорируют дальность для собственных Пойманных целей, а любое Завершение наносит им дополнительный урон Ступени.

canonicalLevel.name: Choke
canonicalLevel.text: Your Body and Talent finishers can always target characters you've snared. Your Finishers deal [Tier] additional damage to Snared characters.

canonicalLevel.name: Twisting Impact
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When "Wrap" moves a character into adjacency with other characters, they each receive [Talent/2] damage.

canonicalLevel.name: Fast Hands
canonicalLevel.text: Once per character per turn, after you leave adjacency with an enemy on your Turn, you may end your movement to do one of the following that you haven't already used this Turn. ‣ Disarm: Weaken them. ‣ Trip: Slow them. ‣ Steal: Gain 2 Focus.

canonicalLevel.name: Snatch
canonicalLevel.text: After you inflict certain Negative Effects on an enemy, you may gain its positive version. The Effects this applies to are as follows. ‣ Blight: Regenerate. ‣ Slow / Snare: Hasten. ‣ Shred: Reinforce. ‣ Weaken: Strengthen.

canonicalLevel.name: Rob Them Blind
canonicalLevel.text: If you used Hide on your Turn, you can use "Fast Hands" without ending your movement. Once per Scene, if you leave all spaces adjacent to the same character, you may Blight, Slow, Shed, Weaken, and deal [Tension] damage to them.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки
интерфейс и журнал должны объяснять подготовленные последствия

canonicalLevel.name: Blendendes Licht
canonicalLevel.text: Your Casts and Spirit Finishers that Crit weaken one of their targets for each Crit rolled.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки
интерфейс и журнал должны объяснять подготовленные последствия

canonicalLevel.name: Sonneneruption
canonicalLevel.text: Your Spirit Finishers affect all targets in a 2x3 Zone centered on you, without targeting you (I.e. in the shape of a "C" around you), and Crit on rolls of 5 or 6 if at least one of the targets has a Negative Effect.

reasons: любая автоматизация проходит предварительную проверку цепочки
интерфейс и журнал должны объяснять подготовленные последствия

canonicalLevel.name: Falscher Stern
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Scene after you charge with at least 2 Tension, you may replace its effect with drawing a full 4 Segment ‘Solar' Clock, and placing a ‘Falscher Stern' marker within 4 range. At the end of your Turn or when an enemy moves out of adjacency with the marker, if you have a Solar Clock, empty one segment and Swiftly Cast at no Cost, targeting all enemies in a 3x3 Zone centered on the Falscher Stern. If it was the last segment use a Spirit Finisher instead, removing the marker and the Clock.

canonicalLevel.name: Sow
canonicalLevel.text: After you Skirmish one Character, you may Teleport them to another space adjacent to you. The first time you use this each Turn, you Mark your target.

rules.name: Уход
rules.note: Помечен удерживается на враге в пределах 3 клеток; уровень I, создающий каноническую Метку, не автоматизирован.

canonicalLevel.name: Tend
canonicalLevel.text: Enemies in 3 range don't lose Marked when they're hit (they still only trigger once per Turn).

canonicalLevel.name: Reap
canonicalLevel.text: If you start your Turn in 5 range of a Marked enemy, you may spend 2 Focus to Teleport to a space adjacent to them and use a Finisher on them at no cost. If you are then in 5 spaces of another Marked enemy, you may repeat this effect at a Focus cost of 1, using a Swift Skirmish instead of a Finisher. This cannot target the same enemy more than once per Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Bloody Brass
canonicalLevel.text: After you Shove a character, Daze them.

canonicalLevel.name: Break And Bruise
canonicalLevel.text: If you Skirmish a Dazed character without using a Technique with the Weapon Tag, it has Advantage equal to the number of different Effects on your target.

canonicalLevel.name: Brutalize
canonicalLevel.text: You may now trigger "Break And Bruise" when targeting Dazed enemies with Body Finishers. The Finishers convert all Advantage from it into additional damage, in addition to Immobilizing and Snaring their target(s) after damage is dealt.

rules.name: Переливание
rules.note: Замена Фокуса Здоровьем работает, но Регенерация ошибочно требует прошедшего урона вместо успешной Атаки.

canonicalLevel.name: Transfusion
canonicalLevel.text: You no longer use Focus. Any increases to your starting Focus increases your max Health instead. If you would spend, or lose Focus, use 2 Health per Focus instead, if you would gain Focus gain an equal amount of Health instead, any of this healing that would be prevented reduces the Focus cost of your next Finisher by the same amount. After you Attack a character with two or more different Effects, begin Regenerating.

rules.name: Перенапряжение
rules.note: Эффект и цена реализованы, но адаптер принимает устаревший успешный удар из журнала вместо текущего окна Атаки.

canonicalLevel.name: Overexert
canonicalLevel.text: After you Attack, you may take 5 damage to roll a D6. Apply an Effect to your target based on the result of the roll. If you have 5 or less Health, you may use this without taking damage. 1-2: Blight 3-4: Daze. 5-6: Immobilize.

rules.name: Рожденный изменчивой плотью
rules.note: Двойной эффект, цели и once/Scene реализованы, но запуск не связан с текущим Завершением и наследует stale-trigger уровня II.

canonicalLevel.name: Born Of Mutable Flesh
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Scene, after you use a Spirit / Body Finisher, you may trigger "Overexert" twice and change the Finisher's targeting to all enemies with more Health than you.

canonicalLevel.name: Stone Soldiers
canonicalLevel.text: As you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher, you may move an Obstacle adjacent to you into a space adjacent to your target. Doing so destroys the Obstacle after the Attack. If there are no Obstacles within 3 spaces of you when you deploy you may create up to 2 of them with 10 health adjacent to you.

canonicalLevel.name: Tectonic Shift
canonicalLevel.text: After you move another character or an Obstacle you didn't create, you create an Obstacle with 10 Health in the space it left. Using Stone soldiers gives the triggering attack 3 Advantage.

canonicalLevel.name: Earthen Shards
canonicalLevel.text: After you destroy or move an Obstacle, you may deal [Spirit] damage to an enemy adjacent to its new or previous position. Each enemy can only be damaged by this effect once per Turn.

canonicalLevel.name: Strong-Arm
canonicalLevel.text: If you Shove, you may move your target up to 5 spaces in a Line instead of 1 space, pushing any characters it would move through to the nearest possible unoccupied space. If you push them adjacent to an opponent, you may Launch all characters involved. You may target Obstacles with your Shoves.

canonicalLevel.name: Piston Fist
canonicalLevel.text: After you Skirmish or Body Finisher a character, you may push them [Body - Target's Armor] spaces.

canonicalLevel.name: Smash Through
canonicalLevel.text: After you move a character into adjacency with an Obstacle, both take [Body] damage. If the Obstacle is destroyed, the character is pushed for another 3 spaces. This additional movement can only be triggered once per move.

canonicalLevel.name: Fluttering Form
canonicalLevel.text: After you end your Turn or are the target of an Attack, you may spend 1 Focus to release a "Swarm" in either your space or the attacker's. Swarms are a unique Field. They stop enemies who move into them like Difficult Terrain, deal [Tier] damage to enemies who move into or start their Turn in the Field, and can be attacked and destroyed as if they were Obstacles with 1 Health. After you start your Turn, you may move each of your Swarms up to 3 spaces.

canonicalLevel.name: Vanish Into Flies
canonicalLevel.text: After you Disappear you may also create 3 Swarms within 2 spaces of the space you left.

canonicalLevel.name: Devour
canonicalLevel.text: When an enemy would take damage from a Swarm while two or more other Swarms are within 2 spaces of the enemy, you may remove those additional Swarms from the board to Blight the enemy who took damage and deal [Tier x 2] damage to them.

rules.name: Ты ведь не причинишь МНЕ боль?
rules.note: После Изучения врага стол предлагает потратить 1 Фокус и наложить Испуган на изученную цель, повторно проверяет цель и общий лимит 3 раза за Сцену и фиксирует применение отдельным событием.

canonicalLevel.name: "You wouldn't hurt ME, would you?"
canonicalLevel.text: Gain 3 Focus at the start of each Scene. After you Investigate an enemy, you may spend 1 Focus to Fear them.

rules.name: Неотразимая
rules.note: Первое за Ход наложение Испуган открывает отменяемый выбор клетки: путь цели до 3 клеток проверяется пошагово на приближение к Сирене, а после фактического входа цели в смежность отдельно предлагает наложить Ошеломлен и только тогда даёт 1 Фокус.

canonicalLevel.name: "I'm Irresistible!"
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Turn, after you Fear a character, you may force them to move up to 3 spaces towards you. If they move into adjacency with you, you may Daze them and gain 1 Focus.

rules.name: Помогите-ка сюда
rules.note: После разрешённого Духовного или Ментального Завершения предлагает подтянуть всех Испуганных врагов к цели Завершения на их Скорость и наносит цели урон Ступени за каждого, кто фактически оказался рядом.

canonicalLevel.name: "A little help over here?"
canonicalLevel.text: After you Spirit or Mind Finisher a character, you may have all enemies affected by Fear move their Speed towards your target and deal [Tier] damage to them if they're adjacent.

rules.name: Мягкие волны
rules.note: Печати сохраняются с лимитом 4+Ступень, а владелец разрешает их срабатывание; Быстрота и бесплатность первого подходящего Заклинания ещё не подключены.

canonicalLevel.name: Gentle Waves
canonicalLevel.text: Your Casts that target one empty space are always Swift, and the first Cast you use on your Turn that fits this condition has no Cost. After you target an empty space with a Cast or Spirit Finisher, you may place a ‘Wave Seal' in that space, up to a maximum of 4 + [Tier] Wave Seals placed at a time. When a character (allies must be willing) start their Turn in or move into a space with a Wave Seal, you may remove it to do one of the following: ‣ Move them up to 2 spaces in a Line. ‣ Launch them.

canonicalLevel.name: Momentous Waves
canonicalLevel.text: After you move yourself or an ally with the effect of a Technique, the character who was moved deals 1 additional damage on their next Attack on their Turn, up to a max of [Spirit].

canonicalLevel.name: Aqua Cage
canonicalLevel.text: If an enemy has a Wave Seal in each of their adjacent spaces, you may remove those Seals to Launch, Daze, and Immobilize them. Each enemy can only be affected by this once per Scene.

canonicalLevel.name: "Where Are You?"
canonicalLevel.text: When you Cast on your turn, you may have it deal no damage to one target, making them ‘think' they're Banished instead. Characters who think they're banished treat themselves as Banished on their turn until they take damage from a player.

rules.name: Что вы делаете?
rules.note: Source-aware Изгнание производит Помечен/Усилен, но канонический способ наложить Изгнание уровнем I отсутствует.

canonicalLevel.name: "Where Am I?"
canonicalLevel.text: Your first Cast each Turn that uses "Where Are You?" is Swift. If you have two or more enemies Banished or who think they're Banished at the end of your Turn, you may move each of them [Mind] spaces. If two or more of them move adjacent to each other, you may force each of them to attack another adjacent enemy, dealing 2 + [their Tier] damage.

rules.name: Кто они?
rules.note: Единственный Изгнанный сохраняет эффект в начале Хода; перемещение двух целей и принудительная Атака отсутствуют.

canonicalLevel.name: "Who Are They?"
canonicalLevel.text: If an enemy starts their Turn and all enemies are Banished or think they're Banished, create two ‘Dark Illusions'. Dark Illusions are NPCS that are always Banished, cannot be targets, and cannot be damaged, cannot take Turns, and are at your Tier. They count as enemies for using "Where Am I?".

rules.name: Растущие ветра
rules.note: Тайфун заменяет прежний и его групповое смещение разрешается владельцем; размещение после Заклинания или Прыжка пока запускается отдельно.

canonicalLevel.name: Growing Winds
canonicalLevel.text: After you Cast targeting an unoccupied space or Jump, you may place a ‘Typhoon' that covers the target space / space you left, and all spaces adjacent to it, replacing all other Typhoons you've created. When a character ends their Turn in a Typhoon, you may push all characters in the Typhoon 1 space in the same direction.

canonicalLevel.name: Updraft
canonicalLevel.text: After you end your Turn you may move any Typhoons 3 spaces in a Line. Any characters who enter the Typhoon through this movement are pushed 1 space in the direction it is moving and are Launched if they are an enemy.

canonicalLevel.name: Mountain Carver
canonicalLevel.text: "Growing Winds" and "Updraft" can now move Obstacles as well as characters. If you move an Obstacle outside of a Typhoon, you may have it continue its movement until it moves adjacent to a character, dealing [Tier] damage to that character. If an Obstacle is moved to the edge of the board through this feature, it is destroyed.

canonicalLevel.name: Steel Jaws
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmishes that target only empty spaces, are Swift. After you target only an empty space with a Skirmish or Mind Finisher, you may place a ‘Small Trap' in that space. When an enemy moves over a Small Trap, their movement is stopped, they're Slowed, and you may swiftly Skirmish them regardless of range at no Cost. Doing this removes the Trap.

rules.name: Дальняя установка
rules.note: Дальность пустой Стычки и Обездвиживание цели ловушки учитываются автоматически.

canonicalLevel.name: Far Setting
canonicalLevel.text: Your Skirmishes that do not target characters have an additional 3 range. Your Skirmishes that come from "Steel Jaws" Immobilize your target.

rules.name: Яма-ловушка
rules.note: Геометрия ямы поддержана; объединение четырёх ловушек и Завершение Разумом ещё не автоматизированы.

canonicalLevel.name: Pit Trap
canonicalLevel.text: If you set a 2x2 area of Small Traps, you may convert them into a "Pit Trap", changing the area into Low Terrain and combining the 4 traps into one "Giant Trap". Giant Traps function identically to Small Traps except they let you use a Mind Finisher on the target instead of a Skirmish.

canonicalLevel.name: Erect
canonicalLevel.text: After you Breathe, you may place a ‘Pillar', a unique kind of "High Ground", on a space within 4 range. After you Charge, you may attempt to connect 3 or more Pillars you've placed with Lines to form a polygon, and then Spirit or Mind Finisher targeting all enemies in this polygon (including those on its lines) at no cost. This removes the Pillars.

canonicalLevel.name: Readjust
canonicalLevel.text: Before connecting the lines when using "Erect", you may Teleport any/all of your Pillars up to 3 spaces in any direction.

canonicalLevel.name: Prison Of Your Own Design
canonicalLevel.text: After you use the Charge portion of "Erect", you may leave the lines on the board until you next use it. The spaces these Lines cover are Difficult Terrain for opponents.

rules.name: Глубокий взгляд
rules.note: Основная ветка работает, но trigger может подобрать старое получение Фокуса от прежней Зарядки вместо текущего события.

canonicalLevel.name: Gaze Deeply
canonicalLevel.text: Before you Charge, you may forgo the Focus you would gain to Immobilize an enemy in a range equal to the Focus you would have gained.

rules.name: Домен контроля
rules.note: После наложения Эффекта предлагает перенос выбранных участников в отдельное пространство 3×3 с возвратом на край поля при Ране или нокауте.

canonicalLevel.name: Domain Of Control
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Scene, after you inflict an Effect, to a character you may Teleport them and yourself to any space in your ‘Inner World', a separate 3x3 board that no other characters have access to. Once you K.O. them or they deal a Wound to you, you Teleport all living characters in your Inner World to a space on the edge of the normal board.

rules.name: Родная территория
rules.note: Бонус Атак и Дуэлей и увеличенный лимит Домена применяются автоматически; составной выбор Домена остаётся решением игрока.

canonicalLevel.name: Home Turf
canonicalLevel.text: While in your Inner World, you gain [Tier] Advantage on all attacks and Duels (this feature carries over to the Duel despite it not being combat). "Domain Of Control" is now [Spirit] times per Scene instead of once per Scene.

rules.name: Взрыв!!
rules.note: Завершение Духом использует авторитетный снимок пула; центр в дальности 4 поражает выбранную клетку и четыре смежные через общий attack pipeline.

canonicalLevel.name: Explosion!!
canonicalLevel.text: Your Spirit Finisher can now choose a target in 4 Range and all targets adjacent to it instead of its normal targeting.

rules.name: Взрыв!!!
rules.note: При фактической оплате 2+ Фокуса Завершение Духом использует перепроверяемую зону 3×3 в дальности 5.

canonicalLevel.name: Explosion!!!
canonicalLevel.text: If you spend 2 or more Focus on a Spirit Finisher, you may have it choose all targets in a 3x3 Zone centered on a space within 5 range. Your Spirit Finishers gain 1 advantage per empty space it targets (to a maximum of [Tier +2] Advantage).

rules.name: ВЗРЫВ!!!!
rules.note: При фактической оплате 4+ Фокуса Завершение Духом использует перепроверяемую и обрезаемую краем поля зону 5×5 в дальности 6.

canonicalLevel.name: EXPLOSION!!!!
canonicalLevel.text: If you spend 4 or more Focus on a Spirit Finisher, you may have it affect all targets in a 5x5 Zone centered on a space within 6 range.

canonicalLevel.name: Proliferate
canonicalLevel.text: Before you Cast or Spirit Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to ‘Rapid Fire' instead. While Rapid Firing, you roll damage before targeting (meaning you cannot be affected by things that apply advantage / disadvantage when targeting) and may divide all damage dealt between any targets within 5 range. You don't need to divide this damage equally.

rules.name: Выжженная земля
rules.note: Размещение трудной местности поддержано; создание только после урона пустой клетке и входной урон ещё требуют общего конвейера.

canonicalLevel.name: Scorched Earth
canonicalLevel.text: After you deal damage to an empty space, you may turn it into Difficult Terrain. The first time enemies move into or start their Turn in Terrain you created each Turn, they receive [Tier] damage.

canonicalLevel.name: Endless Fire [ Charge → Cast ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Cast gains Advantage equal to the number of different enemies within 5 spaces of you + [Tension].

rules.name: Лей-линии
rules.note: Круг и бонус работают, но отдельная кнопка не требует Зарядки и не отказывается от полученного ею Фокуса.

canonicalLevel.name: Ley Lines
canonicalLevel.text: After you Charge, you may place a ‘Spell Circle' in your current space, removing any you've already created. When in a Spell Circle space, your Spirit Finishers can target enemies in 5 range.

canonicalLevel.name: Arcane Artillery
canonicalLevel.text: When affected by a Spell Circle, your first Spirit Finisher each Turn has 3 additional range and gains [Tension] Advantage.

canonicalLevel.name: Fractal Etchings
canonicalLevel.text: If you Charge while on a Spell Circle, you may enhance it for the Scene, doubling the effects of "Arcane Artillery". A Spell Circle can't be enhanced multiple times.

rules.name: Эксперимент
rules.note: Одна изученная Модификация сохраняется в листе, сцене и импорте; каждое применение к Заклинанию или Завершению атомарно тратит 1 Новаторство.

canonicalLevel.name: Experimentation
canonicalLevel.text: Gain one of the ‘Augments' listed below. You start every Scene with [Mind] ‘Innovation' charges, and may spend one of those charges before you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher to apply an Augment you have. These bonuses are as follows: ‣ Dire Augment: Damage dealt by this attack is increased by [Mind]. ‣ Focused Augment: This attack now affects all targets in a 5 space Line adjacent to you. ‣ Wild Augment: This attack now affects all targets in a 2x2 Zone within 3 range. ‣ Salient Augment: The range, and the length of lines created by this attack, are increased by [Mind].

rules.name: Закрепление
rules.note: Новаторство отключается, стартовый Фокус увеличивается на Разум, а изученная Модификация атомарно стоит 1 Фокус за применение.

canonicalLevel.name: Solidification
canonicalLevel.text: Gain an additional Augment. You no longer have Innovation charges and may use Experimentation by spending 1 Focus. Your starting Focus is increased by [Mind].

rules.name: Финализация
rules.note: Второй изученный вариант сохраняется; одно действие может выбрать не более двух разных изученных Модификаций и платит за обе в одной проверяемой цепочке.

canonicalLevel.name: Finalization
canonicalLevel.text: Gain an additional Augment. You may apply two different Augments to any Cast or Finisher so long as you pay for both.

canonicalLevel.name: Power Unleashed [ Charge → Finisher ]
canonicalLevel.text: The Finisher has its Cost reduced to 1. While you use this Finisher, you may spend up to [3 x Tension] Focus.

rules.name: Бесформенная сила · линия
rules.note: Геометрия зональной Атаки поддержана, но она ещё не связана строго с «Высвобожденной мощью».

rules.name: Бесформенная сила · зона 2×2
rules.note: Геометрия зональной Атаки поддержана, но она ещё не связана строго с «Высвобожденной мощью».

canonicalLevel.name: Formless Strength
canonicalLevel.text: If you use "Power Unleashed", you may have it affect all targets in an ∞ length Line or a 2x2 space Zone adjacent to you.

canonicalLevel.name: Moment Of Truth
canonicalLevel.text: If you enter a Duel with 6 or more Focus, you may expend all of it to gain Advantage in that Duel, equal to half the Focus you spent.

canonicalLevel.name: Call Arms
canonicalLevel.text: Choose a Technique with the "Weapon" Tag that you don't have, it's added to your ‘Arsenal'. After you Breathe or Charge, you may ‘Forge' a number of Techniques from your ‘Arsenal' equal to the focus gained. Before you Cast, you may spend a Forge to gain the 1st level of its Technique during the Cast, and make the Cast count as a Skirmish as well.

canonicalLevel.name: Blade Storm
canonicalLevel.text: Add another Weapon Technique to your Arsenal. After you start your Turn with 2 or more Forged Techniques, Strengthen yourself and make your first Cast of that Turn Swift.

canonicalLevel.name: Saintly Sword, Excalibur
canonicalLevel.text: Add a Weapon Technique to your Arsenal. If you Finisher while Strengthened, it targets an enemy within 5 spaces, can use "Call Arms", provides all three levels of the Technique(s) chosen, and counts as a Body / Talent AND Spirit Finisher.

canonicalLevel.name: All Eyes On Me
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Action, after you roll a Crit for any reason, you may spend 1 AP or 3 Focus to ‘Elevate' the roll. If you Elevate, describe how your character adds some dramatic flair or additional detail to the roll they're taking and increase the Tension by 1.

canonicalLevel.name: Snatch Their Fire
canonicalLevel.text: If you increase Tension, create ‘Drama' instead. Drama counts as Tension on player Turns, but does not increase Tension on enemy Turns.

canonicalLevel.name: Power In Presentation
canonicalLevel.text: After you Elevate specific actions, they receive a bonus: ‣ Finisher: Deal [Tension] additional damage (counting the Tension added via Elevate). ‣ Charge: Gain AP equal to the AP spent on this Action (not including AP spent on Elevate). ‣ Cast: You may Mark, Immobilize, Taunt, or Fear your target. If multiple Crits were rolled, choose one additional option for each Crit.

canonicalLevel.name: Vorpal Claw
canonicalLevel.text: Your Cast can now only target one character within 2 range and Snares the target. This overrides any range or targeting modifiers or replacements outside this Technique. You may Roll Body instead of Spirit for Cast's Roll.

rules.name: Сорваться с цепи
rules.note: Создание и жизненный цикл Ярости, ограничения ОД, Быстрые Прыжки и обязательное бесплатное Заклинание по всем смежным персонажам проходят через цели, Реакции, отмену и журнал.

canonicalLevel.name: Unchain [ Charge → Interact]
canonicalLevel.text: If Interact targets you, begin tracking ‘Fury', a 6 Segment Clock, and fill one Segment for each adjacent enemy + [Tension]. If you have Fury Segments, you can only spend AP on Jumps & Finishers, and doing either empties one. In Fury, Jumps are Swift, and after you Jump, Swiftly Cast at no Cost, targeting ALL adjacent targets. When Fury empties, remove it, and you're Dazed.

rules.name: Хватка
rules.note: Завершение Телом может потратить всю Ярость, получить Преимущество от Напряжения и переместиться до 3 клеток перед созданием Атаки.

canonicalLevel.name: Grasp
canonicalLevel.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. If you have at least 1 Fury Segment and you use a Body Finisher, you may spend all your Fury Segments to gain [Tension] Advantage and move up to 3 spaces before targeting.

canonicalLevel.name: Rev Up
canonicalLevel.text: After you Breathe you may ‘Ignite', receiving up to 6 damage and Blighting yourself to receive an additional Focus for every 2 damage taken. You receive half the damage from Blight.

canonicalLevel.name: Damning Impact
canonicalLevel.text: If you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher while Blighted, you gain [Tension] Advantage, and Blight your target. If you would Blight an enemy who's already Blighted, you deal [Tier] damage.

canonicalLevel.name: Ashes To Ashes
canonicalLevel.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. Your Spirit Finisher has a range of 5 and removes Blight from its target and yourself after targeting. If it removes any Blight, it additionally targets enemies in two crossing, diagonal 5 space Lines centered on the target in the shape of an "X".

rules.name: Охлаждение
rules.note: Успешное Заклинание после разрешения Реакций автоматически накладывает Замедлен на доступные цели.

canonicalLevel.name: Chill
canonicalLevel.text: Your successful Casts Slow your target(s).

rules.name: Ледяной нимб
rules.note: Канон: Заклинания получают +1 Преимущество; после фактического получения Фокуса один раз за это Действие заполняется Сосулька; перед Передышкой можно заменить её эффект опустошением часов и уроном [Дух/2] за сегмент, с Ошеломлением Замедленного. Старый quick-Cast/persistent-prompt путь не является доказательством этой механики.

canonicalLevel.name: Icicle Halo
canonicalLevel.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. Begin tracking "Icicle", a 4 Segment Clock that empties after each Scene. Once per Action, after you gain Focus, fill one Segment. Before you Breathe, you may replace its effect with emptying the Clock, dealing [Spirit/2] damage to a character within 5 range for each Segment emptied. If this damage targets a Slow character, Immobilize them.

review.correction: Исправлен контракт четырёхсегментной Сосульки: заполнение после фактического Focus gain один раз за Action и каноническая Breathe replacement ветка.

canonicalLevel.name: Shatter
canonicalLevel.text: Your Spirit Finishers can target enemies in 5 range. After you use a Finisher on an Immobilized character, the Narrator must tell you their Health, if their Health is equal to or lower than [Spirit], you knock them out. After you KO a character using "Shatter", Slow enemies within 3 spaces of the target.

rules.name: Непостоянная мощь
rules.note: После подходящей Зарядки стол предлагает трансформацию и полностью ведёт перенаправление Здоровья, Фокуса, толчок и завершение формы.

canonicalLevel.name: Impermanent Power
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Scene, after you Charge or Awaken this with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', gaining 1 AP, pushing all enemies within 2 range 3 spaces away, and losing your Focus and all but 1 Health, converting both into ‘Corruption'. Corruption is an alt Focus that goes "over" Focus and Health, being lost and gained in place of both, but can't be reset by other Techniques. While Transformed, your first Cast each Turn is Swift. After you're reduced to 0 Corruption, you lose the Transformation and become Dazed.

rules.name: Вытянуть жизнь
rules.note: Канон: после Завершения Духом в форме можно начать Drain Life; источник и цель Ошеломляются до начала следующего Хода любого из них, а если до снятия эффекта оба не получают урон, источник получает [Дух] Фокуса. Старый state-toggle с половиной урона и Регенерацией исключён.

canonicalLevel.name: Drain Life
canonicalLevel.text: After you use a Spirit Finisher while transformed, you may begin ‘Draining' your target, Immobilizing yourself and the target until the start of either of your next Turns. If neither of you take damage before the effect is lost, you gain [Spirit] Focus.

review.correction: Удалён устаревший half-damage/Regeneration state-toggle; зафиксирована opt-in Drain Life ветка с двумя Immobilize источниками и условным Focus reward.

canonicalLevel.name: Umbra
canonicalLevel.text: After you lose your Transformation, you may use a Spirit Finisher targeting yourself and enemies in a 3x3 Zone centered on yourself. If you're Tier 3 or higher, you may Daze yourself and spend 2 Focus to transform as soon as you deploy regardless of Tension.

canonicalLevel.name: Nock The Arrow
canonicalLevel.text: Gain a new Action, ‘Prepare'. Prepare costs 1 AP, is Swift, and gives you one ‘Prep'. Once per Turn, Before you Skirmish or Talent Finisher, spend your Prep to gain 2 additional range & Advantage for each Prep spent, up to a maximum of 6 Prep.

canonicalLevel.name: Feather Step
canonicalLevel.text: After you Prepare, you may move one space so long as you don't move adjacent to an enemy.

canonicalLevel.name: Lord Piercer [ Prepare × 3 ]
canonicalLevel.text: Gain 1 AP, and your next Skirmish or Finisher this Scene (can't stack) affects all targets in an adjacent Line with a length equal to its range. If said Attack targets a character at the attack's maximum Range or the edge of the board, the attack deals additional damage equal to the Prep spent.

rules.name: Реприза воина
rules.note: Точка призыва ставится только в пустую клетку за 1 Фокус, с выбором типа и лимитом [Ступень/2]. Незакрыто: полноценный Призыв-участник с 1 Здоровьем, профильной Атакой, половиной урона и Ходом.

canonicalLevel.name: A Warrior's Reprise
canonicalLevel.text: Your Casts gain 2 Advantage. Before you Cast without a ‘Sellsword' marker, first create one in a space within [Spirit] range. Your Casts only treat spaces adjacent to your Sellsword as being within range. If you move while you have a Sellsword, you may move them the same distance.

canonicalLevel.name: Warrior's Fury
canonicalLevel.text: Once per Round, after you gain Focus while you have a Sellsword, you may use move it [Spirit] spaces and ‘Spark' a character adjacent to it 1/2/3/4 times, based on if you gained at least 1/3/6/10 Focus. Sparks deals [Spirit / 2] damage to its target and count as a Swift Cast; other features cannot change a Spark's targeting or damage.

canonicalLevel.name: Supreme Sellsword
canonicalLevel.text: As you end your Turn, you may spend 6 Focus to replace your Sellsword with a Summoned DPS NPC of your choice at the same Tier as you, placed in the closest unoccupied space. At the start of your next Turn, it returns to being a Sellsword in the same space.

canonicalLevel.name: Return To Nothing
canonicalLevel.text: The first time you Dodge, are Banished, or move to the edge of the board each Round, you can spend 1 Focus to Teleport to another space on the edge of the board.

canonicalLevel.name: Fade Away
canonicalLevel.text: The spaces on the edge of the board and adjacent to enemies are always valid places to Teleport to or return to from being Disappeared.

rules.name: Полое сердце
rules.note: Полная Пустота открывает Завершение Духом по всем врагам центральной зоны 5×5 с половинным уроном и обычными Реакциями.

canonicalLevel.name: Hollow Heart
canonicalLevel.text: Begin tracking ‘Void', a 4 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. After you Teleport, become Banished, or Disappear, fill one Void Segment. After you Teleport adjacent to an enemy while the Void Clock is filled, you may empty the clock to ‘Drown' a character adjacent to you, Banishing both of you and letting you Spirit Finisher them at no Cost. You cannot fill the Void Clock on the same Turn you Drown a character.

rules.name: Райден
rules.note: Передышка предлагает заполнить Статику; непустая Статика автоматически снимает Ошеломлен.

canonicalLevel.name: Raiden
canonicalLevel.text: Begin tracking ‘Static', a 6 Segment Clock that's emptied after each Scene. If you roll more Hits on any roll than you have Static Segments, Hasten yourself and fill a Static Segment, or two segments if at least one of those rolls were a Crit. After you fill this clock, empty it, Daze yourself, and Swiftly Cast targeting all enemies within 4 range.

rules.name: Заряженное заклинание
rules.note: После успешного Заклинания явный выбор исходной цели проводит Скачок, Разряд или Цепь через расход Статики, Ошеломление, проверку целей, новый бросок, Реакции, отмену и журнал.

canonicalLevel.name: Energized Incantation
canonicalLevel.text: After you Cast, you can empty a Static Segment to do one of the following: ‣ Blink: Teleport to a space adjacent to your target. ‣ Shock: Inflict Daze. ‣ Chain: Swiftly Cast a different enemy in 5 range of initial target at no cost (this cannot spend static).

rules.name: Разрядка
rules.note: При 3+ Статики Завершение Духом собирает зону 3×3 без владельца, добавляет Ступень урона уже Ошеломленным и после Успеха накладывает Ошеломлен.

canonicalLevel.name: Tactical Discharge
canonicalLevel.text: While you have at least 3 Static, Your Casts Crit on 5s or 6s. If you fill your Static Clock by casting or using a Spirit Finisher, you may Teleport to a space within 4 range before emptying it.

rules.name: Еретическая преданность
rules.note: Публичный бросок с единицей предлагает потратить Фокус и заполнить Озарение; Зарядка, Заклинание и Завершение Духом умеют потратить сегмент и инвертировать итоговые Успехи.

canonicalLevel.name: Heretical Devotion
canonicalLevel.text: Begin tracking ‘Insight', a 6 Segment Clock that's emptied after each Scene. Once per Action, after you roll a 1 for any reason, you may spend 1 Focus to fill an Insight Segment. If you Charge, Cast, or Spirit Finisher, you may empty an Insight Segment to have your final Hit count treated as [Spirit + Tier] x 2 minus the number of Hits rolled.

rules.name: Всегда под взглядом, утоплен в слезах
rules.note: Начало Хода при четырёх сегментах предлагает Усиление и записывает отдельное наложение Испуган каждым персонажем.

canonicalLevel.name: Freak
canonicalLevel.text: After you start your Turn with 4 or more Insight Segments filled, you may Strengthen yourself and have every character inflict Fear on you.

rules.name: Так не должно было быть
rules.note: Полное Озарение открывает Завершение Духом по двум пересекающимся Линиям; стол последовательно проверяет сдвиг каждого персонажа, атомарно очищает часы, уничтожает связанную местность, удаляет клетки и ведёт обычную цепочку Реакций.

canonicalLevel.name: Never Meant To Be
canonicalLevel.text: If you use a Spirit Finisher with a full Insight Clock, you may empty all the Segments to have it target two intersecting ∞ length lines anywhere on the board. All targets are moved one space off of the line in a direction of your choice and all spaces on the line are removed from the game, destroying any Obstacle on them or connected to them. If a character would enter one of these spaces, they are instead Teleported to the closest space on the opposite side of the Line.

rules.name: Формирование знаков
rules.note: Метки творения заменяют Фокус; обычная Атака с Метками направляется к подходящей форме.

canonicalLevel.name: Forming Signs
canonicalLevel.text: You now use ‘Material' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with no Material. You can only gain Material using Breathe and Charge. If you make an attack with any amount of Material, you must spend all of them and gain an effect based on the number spent and the Attack used. 1-2 & Cast: Crossing Nails: Target two adjacent 3 space Lines where at least 1 space of each overlaps. 3+ & Cast: Impossible Mallet: Target every enemy exactly 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 spaces away from you (choose one), dealing additional damage equal to this number and making the spaces low ground. 1-2 & Finisher: Celestial Pile-Arm: Gain 2 Advantage. Your target is pushed as far as possible, and receives one damage for every space pushed 3+ & Finisher: Living Idol Gain 4 Advantage. Target up to 6 spaces adjacent to each other where one is adjacent to you, these spaces become high ground.

rules.name: Один истинный мир
rules.note: Передышка, Зарядка и получение Меток от повреждения или уничтожения местности автоматизированы.

canonicalLevel.name: One True World
canonicalLevel.text: Your first Breath you use on your turn is Swift. Your Charge has its cost reduced to 1. After you deal damage to or destroy an Obstacle you gain a Material.

rules.name: Труд благочестивых
rules.note: Форма Завершения получает число Меток непосредственно предшествовавшего Заклинания.

canonicalLevel.name: Labor Of The Devout [ Cast → Finisher ]
canonicalLevel.text: This Finisher counts as having spent an equal amount of Material as the Cast used before it.

canonicalLevel.name: I Am Your Sword
canonicalLevel.text: After Deploying or Breathing you may target an adjacent willing ally and ‘Equip' to them, making them your ‘Wielder'. While Transformed you take up your Wielder's space, you can use their attributes for rolls, you don't count as a target, and you can't move. If your Wielder takes a Wound you do too. Either of you can split at the start of your Turns, placing you in an unoccupied adjacent space.

rules.name: Покажи свои цели
rules.note: Нужна модель носителя/трансформации: в каноне маркеры ставятся в конце Хода на клетках всех врагов, атакованных носителем; текущий произвольный выбор клетки нельзя показывать как автоматизацию.

canonicalLevel.name: Show Your Targets
canonicalLevel.text: You may move on your Turn while Equipped, moving your Wielder with you.

canonicalLevel.name: And I'll Become Irreplaceable
canonicalLevel.text: After you Equip, determine you and your wielder's highest combined Attribute (choosing between ties), and give both of you a feature based on what it is; Body: Heavy Arm: Before targeting with Finishers, move up to 3 spaces in a Line, dealing [Partner's Body] damage to enemies you move adjacent to. Talent: Bladed Arm: When moving, you ignore enemies and gain [Partner's Talent] Evasion if you moved through at least one enemy. Spirit: Ranged Arm: Your Finishers can target characters up to [Partner's Spirit] spaces away. When they target one character at that range exactly, they also deal [Your Spirit] additional damage. Mind: Complex Arm: At the end of your Turn Mark all enemies you attacked. After you attack a Marked enemy, gain [Partner's Mind] Focus.
